makaleler.baslik: Long-term oncological outcomes of robotic versus laparoscopic total mesorectal excision for rectal cancer: COLRAR randomized clinical trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Rektum kanserinde robotik ve laparoskopik TME'nin uzun dönem sonuçları: COLRAR RCT
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 295 rektum kanserli hastanın dahil edildiği çok merkezli RCT'de, 5 yıllık genel sağkalım (%92,6'ya karşı %92,4; p=0,838) ve hastalıksız sağkalım (%81,9'a karşı %83,0; p=0,801) R-TME ve L-TME gruplarında benzer bulunmuştur. Neoadjuvan KRT alan 146 hastada, 5 yıllık lokal nükssüz sağkalım R-TME ile %98,6, L-TME ile %90,7 saptanmıştır (p=0,039).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Long-term oncological equivalence of robotic total mesorectal excision (R-TME) and laparoscopic total mesorectal excision (L-TME) remains unproven. The 5-year outcomes of the COLRAR RCT are reported.
METHODS: Adults with cT1-4a Nx M0 rectal adenocarcinoma within 10 cm of the anal verge were randomized 1 : 1 to L-TME or R-TME at three Korean tertiary centres between July 2011 and February 2016. Pre-specified secondary endpoints were 5-year overall, relapse-free, local recurrence-free, and distant recurrence-free survival. Analyses were on a modified intention-to-treat basis.
RESULTS: Of 295 analysed patients (144 L-TME patients and 151 R-TME patients; median follow-up of 72.6 months), 5-year overall survival (92.6% versus 92.4%; P = 0.838) and relapse-free survival (81.9% versus 83.0%; P = 0.801) were similar. Local recurrence occurred in 4.9% (L-TME) and 1.3% (R-TME); 5-year local recurrence-free and distant recurrence-free survival did not differ (P = 0.076 and P = 0.655). In a post-hoc analysis of 146 patients who received neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy, 5-year local recurrence-free survival was 98.6% in R-TME patients versus 90.7% in L-TME patients (P = 0.039).
CONCLUSION: R-TME and L-TME produced equivalent 5-year oncological outcomes. A post-hoc analysis suggested improved local control with robotic surgery after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy, requiring confirmation in prospectively designed studies.
REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT01423214 (http://www.clinicaltrials.gov).

makaleler.baslik: Three-week ileostomy closure after colorectal surgery: a multicenter randomized trial of technical and postoperative outcomes.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Kolorektal cerrahi sonrası 3. haftada ileostomi kapatılması: Çok merkezli RCT
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Restoratif kolorektal rezeksiyon yapılan 224 hastanın alındığı çok merkezli RCT'de, 3. haftada erken ileostomi kapatılması (112 hasta) erteleme grubuyla (112 hasta) karşılaştırılmıştır. Erken kapatmada operasyon süresi daha kısa (90±12'ye karşı 130±18 dk; p<0,001) ve adesyolizis ihtiyacı daha düşük (%5,4'e karşı %21,4; p<0,001) saptanmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: The optimal timing of temporary ileostomy closure following restorative colorectal surgery remains controversial. Although previous randomized studies have demonstrated the feasibility of early closure in carefully selected patients, the influence of closure timing on operative complexity has not been prospectively evaluated. This multicenter randomized controlled trial compared a standardized 3-week ileostomy closure strategy with conventional delayed closure, with particular emphasis on technical and postoperative outcomes.
METHODS: In this prospective multicenter randomized controlled trial, 224 patients undergoing restorative colorectal resection with temporary diverting ileostomy were randomized to either early ileostomy closure at 3 weeks (n = 112) or conventional delayed closure (n = 112). Eligibility for reversal required rigorous confirmation of anastomotic healing using standardized clinical and endoscopic assessment, with selective computed tomography using rectal contrast when clinically indicated. The primary outcome was operative complexity, evaluated using operative duration, intraoperative adhesion severity, and the requirement for extended adhesiolysis. Secondary outcomes included postoperative morbidity, Clavien-Dindo complication grade, length of hospital stay, readmission, reoperation, re-diversion, and delay in adjuvant chemotherapy.
RESULTS: Baseline demographic, clinical, and operative characteristics were comparable between the study groups. Early ileostomy closure was associated with significantly shorter operative duration (90 ± 12 vs. 130 ± 18 min; P < 0.001), substantially lower intraoperative adhesion severity (P = 0.04), and a markedly reduced requirement for extended adhesiolysis (5.4% vs. 21.4%; P < 0.001). Overall postoperative morbidity, Clavien-Dindo grade distribution, postoperative length of stay, readmission, reoperation, and mortality were comparable between groups. Delays in adjuvant chemotherapy occurred only in the early-closure group (3.6%), were limited to 1-4 weeks, and all affected patients subsequently commenced the planned oncologic treatment.
CONCLUSIONS: In carefully selected patients with confirmed anastomotic healing, 3-week ileostomy closure is a technically feasible and safe strategy following restorative colorectal surgery. Compared with conventional delayed closure, reversal at 3 weeks significantly reduced operative complexity without compromising short-term postoperative outcomes. These findings support selective implementation of a standardized 3-week ileostomy closure strategy and identify operative complexity as a key determinant when selecting the optimal timing of ileostomy reversal.
GOV IDENTIFIER: NCT05192018.

makaleler.baslik: Prediction Models for Pathological Response to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Lokal İleri Rektum Kanserinde Patolojik Yanıt Tahmin Modelleri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 67302 hastayı içeren 43 çalışmanın meta-analizinde neoadjuvan chemoradiotherapy sonrası patolojik tam yanıtı öngören modellerin pooled AUC değeri 0,874 (%95 CI: 0,855-0,892) olarak bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet: Background: Accurate pretreatment prediction of pCR is critical for stratifying patients with LARC and selecting candidates for organ-preserving approaches. However, pCR is a postoperative pathological endpoint, whereas watch-and-wait strategies are based on cCR. Despite a rapidly expanding literature encompassing gene expression signatures, MRI radiomics, deep learning, and multi-modal fusion models, no prior systematic review has comprehensively evaluated predictive performance across all modalities using contemporary meta-analytic techniques for diagnostic test accuracy. Methods: Systematic review and random- effects meta-analysis of studies developing or validating predictive models for pCR in LARC treated with neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (nCRT) were conducted. Summary AUC was estimated using logit-transformed random-effects models. Heterogeneity was quantified by I2 and τ2. Subgroup analyses were performed according to model modality and validation strategy. Publication bias was assessed with Egger's linear regression test. Sensitivity analyses were performed using leave-one-out cross-validation. Results: Forty-three studies with 67,302 patients were included. The pooled AUC across all models was 0.874 (95% CI: 0.855-0.892), with substantial heterogeneity (I2 = 94.3%, τ2 = 0.247). Deep learning models showed the highest pooled AUC (0.919, 95% CI: 0.877-0.948), with MRI radiomics (0.885, 95% CI: 0.852-0.911), multi-modal (0.875, 95% CI: 0.813-0.919), gene expression (0.855, 95% CI: 0.797-0.898), and clinical factors (0.820, 95% CI: 0.788-0.849) showing progressively lower pooled estimates. External validation cohorts had a lower pooled AUC (0.864) than internal validation (0.884). Significant publication bias was detected (Egger's test p < 0.001). Leave-one-out sensitivity analysis confirmed robustness of the overall estimate. Conclusions: Deep learning and MRI radiomics models demonstrate promising diagnostic accuracy for predicting pCR after nCRT in LARC. However, the predominance of retrospective, single-center designs with limited external validation represents a critical translational gap, and the lack of studies in the total neoadjuvant therapy era limits generalizability. Prospective, multicenter validation studies incorporating standardized endpoints and class imbalance-appropriate metrics are urgently needed.

makaleler.baslik: Comparative effectiveness of modified ileostomy techniques in rectal cancer surgery: A systematic review and network meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Rektum kanseri cerrahisinde modifiye ileostomi tekniklerinin karşılaştırılması: Ağ meta-analizi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 1.402 hastayı içeren 16 çalışmalı ağ meta-analizinde farklı ileostomi teknikleri değerlendirilmiştir. Sürekli intradermal sütür operasyon süresini kısaltırken, 1-stitch tekniği iyileşmeyi hızlandırmış, çoklu sütür teknikleri ise stoma prolapsusunu ve stenozunu önlemede üstün bulunmuştur. Kanama ve parastomal hernia açısından fark saptanmamıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: This systematic review and network meta-analysis evaluates the efficacy and safety of different ileostomy methods (conventional, 1-stitch, modified 1-stitch, prolapse technique + 1-stitch, and modified 2-stitch) in ileostomy and stoma reversal surgery and ranks their effectiveness.
METHODS: We searched 8 databases (PubMed, Cochrane, Embase, Web of Science, CNKI, Wanfang, VIP, and SinoMed) from inception to December 2025. Interventions included 1-stitch, prolapse + 1-stitch, modified 1-stitch, continuous intradermal suture, modified 2-stitch, simple support + 1-stitch, 3-stitch, and 2-stitch.
RESULTS: A total of 16 studies (1,402 patients, 9 interventions) were included. Different ileostomy methods showed differential advantages across clinical indicators. Continuous intradermal suture significantly shortened total ileostomy duration and reduced stoma retraction. Prolapse surgery + 1-stitch was associated with shorter phase I hospitalization and stoma exhaust time. Simple support bracket + 1-stitch was associated with less blood loss during reversal surgery. One-stitch shortened the interval of reversal surgery and the length of hospitalization postreversal surgery. Modified 2-stitch was associated with a lower incidence of overall complications. Three-stitch + innovative knotting effectively prevented stoma stenosis and skin-mucosal separation, whereas 3-stitch alone prevented stoma prolapse. No statistically significant differences were observed for intraoperative blood loss, parastomal hernia, irritant dermatitis, stoma infection, or ischemia/necrosis.
CONCLUSION: Modified ileostomy techniques appear better than conventional methods in surgical efficiency, postoperative recovery, and complication control. Continuous intradermal suture is associated with shorter operative duration. The 1-stitch technique and its derivatives promote postoperative recovery. Multistitch techniques are better at preventing stoma prolapse and stenosis. However, because of the absence of closed loops in the evidence network and the predominantly retrospective study design, these findings may be overestimated.

makaleler.baslik: Timing of diverting ileostomy closure after low anterior resection for rectal cancer: a GRADE-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis of early and delayed closure.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Rektum kanserinde saptırıcı ileostomi kapatılma zamanlaması: Sistematik derleme ve meta-analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 512 hastayı kapsayan 5 çalışmanın meta-analizinde, erken ve geciktirilmiş ileostomi kapatılması karşılaştırılmıştır. Genel morbidite açısından gruplar arasında anlamlı fark bulunmamıştır (52/257'ye karşı 50/255; RR 1,06, %95 CI 0,66-1,71). Erken kapatma ile stoma süresi 107,09 gün kısalmış, ancak hastanede kalış ve ameliyat süresi değişmemiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: To compare early and delayed diverting ileostomy closure after low anterior resection for rectal cancer, focusing on postoperative morbidity and recovery outcomes, and to assess the certainty of available evidence.
METHODS: PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched from inception to 26th April, 2026. Five comparative studies (four randomized trials and one prospective cohort; 512 participants) were included. Random-effects meta-analyses evaluated overall post-closure morbidity as the primary outcome and severe complications, index-to-closure interval, postoperative hospital stay, operative time, and reoperation as secondary outcomes. Certainty was assessed using GRADE.
RESULTS: Overall morbidity occurred in 52/257 patients after early closure and 50/255 after delayed closure (RR 1.06, 95% CI 0.66-1.71; τ²=0.12; I²=40%). Severe complications and reoperation did not differ statistically, with confidence intervals compatible with benefit or harm. The index-to-closure interval was 107.09 days shorter with early closure (95% CI - 153.01 to - 61.17; τ²=2023.39; I²=96%); this process measure was largely inherent to the group definitions. Hospital stay and operative time did not differ statistically.
CONCLUSION: The available evidence does not demonstrate a statistically significant difference in postoperative morbidity but does not establish equivalence. Early closure may be considered in selected patients after postoperative recovery and assessment of anastomotic integrity; however, these findings do not support routine early closure in all patients.

tez.baslik: Lokal ileri rektum kanserinde total neoadjuvan tedavi sonrası patolojik tam yanıtı etkileyen faktörler
tez.baslik_tr: Lokal İleri Rektum Kanserinde TNT Sonrası Patolojik Tam Yanıt Faktörleri
tez.kisa_ozet: Tek merkezli retrospektif çalışmada yüksek CEA düzeyinin pCR olasılığını azalttığı (OR: 0,311; %95 GA: 0,125-0,777; p=0,012) gösterilmiştir.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Total neoadjuvan tedavi (TNT), lokal ileri rektum kanserinde (LARC) patolojik tam yanıt (pCR) oranlarını artırmış olmakla birlikte tam yanıtı öngörebilen klinik ve laboratuvar belirteçler henüz tutarlı biçimde tanımlanamamıştır. Bu çalışmada, LARC tanısıyla TNT sonrası cerrahi uygulanan hastalarda pCR oranının belirlenmesi ve bu yanıtı etkileyen klinik, laboratuvar, radyolojik ve patolojik faktörlerin retrospektif olarak değerlendirilmesi amaçlanmıştır. Gereç ve Yöntem: Ocak 2020 – Şubat 2026 tarihleri arasında tek merkezli retrospektif gözlemsel çalışmada, TNT sonrası total mezorektal eksizyon (TME) prensiplerine uygun cerrahi rezeksiyon uygulanan LARC hastaları değerlendirildi. Çalışmanın birincil sonlanımı pCR olarak belirlendi; pCR, AJCC 8. baskı evrelemesinde ypT0N0 ve College of American Pathologists 2021 tümör regresyon skorunun 0 olması şeklinde tanımlandı. Demografik, klinik, laboratuvar, radyolojik ve patolojik değişkenler pCR durumuna göre karşılaştırıldı. Univariate analizde p 5 ng/mL) pCR olasılığını azaltan (OR: 0,311; %95 GA: 0,125–0,777; p=0,012), HALP indeksi ise pCR olasılığını artıran (OR: 1,020; p=0,036) bağımsız prediktörler olarak tespit edildi. Müsinöz karsinom histolojisinde (p=0,045) ve indüksiyon kemoterapisi uygulananlarda (p=0,027) pCR olasılığı istatistiksel olarak anlamlı düzeyde düşük bulundu. Sonuç: TNT uygulanan LARC hastalarında tedavi öncesi yüksek CEA düzeyi, pCR olasılığını azaltan bağımsız bir prediktör olarak bulunmuştur. Tedavi öncesi HALP indeksi de pCR ile bağımsız ilişki göstermekle birlikte bu bulgunun prospektif çalışmalarla doğrulanması gerekmektedir.. Müsinöz karsinom histolojisi ve indüksiyon kemoterapisi pCR ile anlamlı ilişki göstermiş, ancak bağımsız prediktör konumuna ulaşamamıştır. Bu bulgular, TNT sonrası bireyselleştirilmiş tedavi planlamasında klinik, radyolojik ve laboratuvar parametrelerinin multidisipliner değerlendirmesinin gerekliliğini desteklemektedir. Anahtar Kelimeler: Karsinoembriyonik antijen, lokal ileri rektum kanseri, patolojik tam yanıt, prognostik faktörler, total neoadjuvan tedavi

makaleler.baslik: ACR Appropriateness Criteria® Staging and Follow-Up of Biliary Cancer.
makaleler.baslik_tr: ACR Uygunluk Kriterleri: Safra Yolu Kanserlerinin Evrelemesi ve Takibi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: ACR uzman panelince hazırlanan rehberde, safra kesesi ve kolanjiyokarsinom evrelemesi değerlendirilmiştir. Lokorejyonel evrelemede kontrastlı CT ve MRI ana yöntemlerken, uzak metastaz evrelemesi ve takipte toraks/batın/pelvis CT ile FDG-PET önerilmektedir.
makaleler.ozet: Biliary tract cancers, comprising gallbladder cancer and intrahepatic and extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, are uncommon but aggressive malignancies that are often diagnosed at an advanced stage. Accurate staging is critical because patients with localized disease may be candidates for curative resection, whereas those with unresectable or metastatic disease are triaged to systemic and palliative therapy. This document reviews the evidence for imaging in five clinical scenarios: locoregional staging of gallbladder cancer, locoregional staging of cholangiocarcinoma, staging of distant metastatic disease, posttreatment evaluation, and surveillance. Contrast-enhanced CT and MRI of the abdomen are the mainstays of locoregional assessment, whereas CT of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis and FDG-PET are used for distant staging and follow-up. The American College of Radiology Appropriateness Criteria are evidence-based guidelines for specific clinical conditions that are reviewed annually by a multidisciplinary expert panel. The guideline development and revision process support the systematic analysis of the medical literature from peer reviewed journals. Established methodology principles such as Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation or GRADE are adapted to evaluate the evidence. The RAND/UCLA Appropriateness Method User Manual provides the methodology to determine the appropriateness of imaging and treatment procedures for specific clinical scenarios. In those instances where peer reviewed literature is lacking or equivocal, experts may be the primary evidentiary source available to formulate a recommendation.
makaleler.dergi_tam: Journal of the American College of Radiology : JACR

makaleler.baslik: Reappraising Liver Transplantation for Combined Hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Kombine Hepatoselüler-Kolanjiyokarsinomda Karaciğer Naklinin Yeniden Değerlendirilmesi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Prospektif veritabanından alınan 79 LT ve 32 LR hastasının incelendiği çalışmada, cHCC-CCA'da LT ile 5 yıllık OS (%89,9'a karşı %65,6; p=0,007) ve RFS (%84,8'e karşı %53,1; p=0,001) yüksek bulundu. UCSF kriterleri içindeki hastalarda bu üstünlük korundu. Mikrovasküler invazyon (HR 25,01) nüksü öngördü.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To determine whether liver transplantation (LT) confers durable oncologic benefit in combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma (cHCC-CCA) and to identify predictors of recurrence that may guide transplant candidacy.
BACKGROUND: cHCC-CCA is a rare primary liver malignancy with aggressive biological behavior. LT has traditionally been contraindicated due to concerns regarding recurrence. We evaluated long-term outcomes of LT versus liver resection (LR) and compared LT outcomes for cHCC-CCA with those for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).
METHODS: Patients with cHCC-CCA who underwent LT or LR between 2010 and 2024 were identified from a prospective database. Survival outcomes, recurrence patterns, and risk factors for recurrence were analyzed. Outcomes of LT for cHCC-CCA were additionally compared with HCC.
RESULTS: A total of 79 patients underwent LT (diagnosed on explant) and 32 underwent LR for cHCC-CCA. 5-year overall survival (OS) and recurrence-free survival (RFS) were superior following LT compared with LR (OS: 89.9% vs. 65.6%, P=0.007; RFS: 84.8% vs. 53.1%, P=0.001). This benefit was maintained for tumors within UCSF criteria [overall survival (88.7% LT vs. 65.6% LR, log rank P 0.014) and RFS (89.8% LT vs. 51.6% LR, P<0.001)]. Among LT recipients, OS for cHCC-CCA was comparable to HCC (89.9% vs. 86%, P=0.721). Within the LT cohort, macrovascular invasion (HR 25.01, P=0.003) and poor tumor differentiation (HR 7.29, P=0.004) independently predicted recurrence.
CONCLUSION: In carefully selected patients, cHCC-CCA within UCSF criteria can achieve transplant outcomes comparable to HCC. Macrovascular invasion and poor tumor differentiation are major predictors of recurrence and may inform candidate selection for LT.

makaleler.baslik: Laparoscopic Versus Open Liver Resection for Colorectal Liver Metastases : An Individual Participant Data Meta-analysis of Four Randomized Clinical Trials.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Kolorektal Karaciğer Metastazlarında Laparoskopik ve Açık Rezeksiyon: IPDMA Çalışması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 4 RCT'nin 761 hastasını (384 laparoskopik, 377 açık) kapsayan IPDMA meta-analizinde, laparoskopik rezeksiyonda postoperatif morbidite belirgin şekilde düşük bulundu (%19'a karşı %27). 93 aylık medyan takipte genel sağkalım ve hastalıksız sağkalım gruplar arasında benzer saptandı.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Randomized clinical trials (RCTs) have compared laparoscopic liver resection (LLR) and open liver resection (OLR) for colorectal liver metastases (CRLM); however, long-term outcomes and subgroup effects have not been comprehensively evaluated.
PURPOSE: To compare postoperative and long-term oncologic outcomes after LLR versus OLR for CRLM using individual participant data from RCTs.
DATA SOURCES: PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials were searched from database inception through March 2025 for RCTs comparing LLR and OLR for CRLM.
STUDY SELECTION: Eligible studies were RCTs comparing LLR and OLR for CRLM.
DATA EXTRACTION: Individual participant data, including unpublished data, were obtained from trial investigators of all 4 published RCTs.
DATA SYNTHESIS: Analyses used a modified intention-to-treat approach and 1-stage individual participant data meta-analysis (IPDMA) with trial-adjusted regression models and g-computation to estimate standardized treatment effects across outcomes, with 95% CIs obtained by nonparametric bootstrap resampling. Prespecified subgroup analyses assessed heterogeneity of treatment effect for the primary outcome. A total of 761 patients were included (laparoscopic, n = 384; open, n = 377). Postoperative morbidity was lower in patients assigned to laparoscopic surgery compared with open surgery (19% vs. 27%). Among patients who received preoperative systemic therapy, morbidity did not differ between groups (25% vs. 24%). Ninety-day mortality was 1.8% after LLR and 0.8% after OLR. After a median follow-up of 93 months, overall survival and disease-free survival did not differ between groups.
LIMITATION: Analyses were limited to variables available across all studies.
CONCLUSION: In this IPDMA of all published RCTs in the field, LLR for CRLM was associated with lower postoperative morbidity than OLR, with similar long-term oncologic outcomes.
PRIMARY FUNDING SOURCE: None. (PROSPERO: CRD42024502655).

makaleler.baslik: Indocyanine green fluorescence-guided versus conventional laparoscopic hepatectomy for hepatocellular carcinoma: A propensity score-matched time-to-event meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: HCC'de İndosiyanin Yeşili Florasan Rehberliğinde Laparoskopik Hepatektomi: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 6 PSM çalışmayı (686 hasta) inceleyen meta-analizde, ICG florasan rehberliğindeki laparoskopik hepatektomide ölüm riski (HR 0,67; %95 CI 0,46-0,99), açığa geçiş (RR 0,15) ve enfeksiyon (RR 0,33) daha düşük bulundu. Ameliyat süresi ve R0 rezeksiyonda fark saptanmadı; mevcut kanıtların güvenilirliği çok düşüktür.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Indocyanine green fluorescence imaging is increasingly used during laparoscopic hepatectomy to improve intraoperative visualization and surgical precision; however, its effect on perioperative and oncologic outcomes in hepatocellular carcinoma remains uncertain.
METHODS: We conducted a Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses-compliant systematic review and meta-analysis of propensity score-matched studies comparing indocyanine green guided with conventional laparoscopic hepatectomy in adults with hepatocellular carcinoma. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials were searched from inception to June 2026. Random-effects models were used to pool hazard ratios, risk ratios, and mean differences. Certainty of evidence was assessed using Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation.
RESULTS: Six retrospective propensity score-matched studies involving 686 patients were included. Indocyanine green-guided laparoscopic hepatectomy was associated with a lower hazard of death (hazard ratio, 0.67; 95% confidence interval, 0.46-0.99), fewer conversions to open surgery (risk ratio, 0.15; 95% confidence interval, 0.04-0.66), and a lower postoperative infection rate (risk ratio, 0.33; 95% confidence interval, 0.14-0.83). However, the conversion and infection findings were based on few studies and events and should be considered exploratory. Intraoperative blood loss was lower, but substantial heterogeneity limited this estimate. No significant differences were observed in operative time, hospital stay, R0 resection, recurrence-related outcomes, or most postoperative complications. The evidence was limited by serious risk of bias, protocol heterogeneity, and very low certainty.
CONCLUSION: Current evidence does not demonstrate a consistent clinical benefit or superiority of indocyanine green-guided laparoscopic hepatectomy. Although associations with a lower hazard of death, conversion to open surgery, and postoperative infection were observed, these findings are exploratory because of the retrospective evidence, sparse events, residual confounding, and substantial heterogeneity in indocyanine green protocols. Standardized protocols and well-designed prospective studies are required.

makaleler.baslik: Survival benefits and prognostic models of surgical resection versus continued medical treatment in CNLC stage IIb/IIIa hepatocellular carcinoma after meeting resectability criteria following conversion therapy.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Evre IIb/IIIa HCC'de Dönüşüm Tedavisi Sonrası Cerrahi Rezeksiyonun Sağkalım Yararları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Dönüşüm tedavisi sonrası rezektabilite kazanan 363 CNLC evre IIb/IIIa HCC hastasının analizinde (PSM sonrası 63 cerrahi, 189 medikal), cerrahide mOS (32,1'e karşı 24,3 ay; p<0,0001) ve mPFS (15,3'e karşı 10,6 ay; p=0,0041) daha yüksek saptandı. Rezektabilite sonrası 90 gün içinde cerrahi yapılması önerilmektedir.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: The combination of targeted therapy, immunotherapy, and locoregional treatment has established conversion therapy as a viable strategy for China Liver Cancer Staging (CNLC) stage IIb/IIIa hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). However, upon meeting the criteria for tumor resectability after successful conversion, it remains controversial whether surgical resection (SR) provides superior survival benefits compared to continued medical treatment (CMT), and the optimal timing for surgery is still undefined.
METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 363 CNLC stage IIb/IIIa HCC patients who met strict tumor resectability criteria after a conversion regimen of lenvatinib, anti-PD-1 antibodies, and transarterial chemoembolization (TACE). Patients were randomly assigned to a training cohort (n = 255) and an internal validation cohort (n = 108) at a 7:3 ratio. Propensity score matching (PSM) was utilized to balance the baseline characteristics. Survival outcomes were compared and prognostic nomograms were developed using Cox proportional hazards regression.
RESULTS: After 1:3 PSM, the training cohort comprised 63 SR patients and 189 CMT patients. The SR group demonstrated significantly better median overall survival (mOS, 32.1 vs. 24.3 months; P < 0.0001) and median progression-free survival (mPFS, 15.3 vs. 10.6 months; P = 0.0041) than the CMT group. The prognostic nomograms developed for both groups exhibited excellent discrimination via bootstrap resampling and in the internal validation cohort. Restricted cubic spline (RCS) and Kaplan-Meier analyses revealed that an interval > 90 days from meeting resectability criteria to surgery, and a pre-operative AFP to baseline AFP (at the time resectability was met) ratio > 1, were significantly associated with worse OS.
CONCLUSION: For CNLC stage IIb/IIIa HCC patients achieving tumor resectability following conversion therapy, SR is significantly associated with improved survival outcomes compared to CMT. Based on our exploratory findings, surgery within 90 days of meeting resectability criteria may be considered a beneficial strategy, provided that the pre-operative AFP level does not exceed the level observed when resectability was initially achieved.

tez.baslik: Siklofosfamid ile indüklenmiş ratlarda karaciğer hasarına karşı mezenkimal kök hücre eksozomlarının koruyucu etkinliği
tez.baslik_tr: Rat Karaciğer Hasarında Mezenkimal Kök Hücre Eksozomlarının Koruyucu Etkinliği
tez.kisa_ozet: 28 rat üzerinde yapılan deneysel çalışmada, siklofosfamid ile indüklenen hepatotoksisiteye karşı kemik iliği kaynaklı mezenkimal kök hücre eksozomlarının etkisi incelenmiştir. Eksozom tedavisinin serum AST, ALT, LDH ve MDA düzeylerini düşürdüğü, antioksidan enzimleri artırdığı ve histopatolojik hasarı belirgin azalttığı saptanmıştır.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışmada, siklofosfamid ile oluşturulan deneysel karaciğer hasarında kemik iliği kaynaklı mezenkimal kök hücre eksozomlarının olası koruyucu etkilerinin biyokimyasal, histopatolojik ve immünohistokimyasal yöntemlerle değerlendirilmesi amaçlandı. Gereç ve Yöntem: Çalışmada toplam 28 adet Wistar albino rat kullanıldı ve denekler rastgele dört gruba ayrıldı (n=7): Sham, BMSC-exos, CP ve CP+BMSC-exos. Karaciğer hasarı oluşturmak amacıyla CP grubundaki deneklere tek doz 200 mg/kg CP intraperitoneal (i.p.) olarak uygulandı. Tedavi grubuna CP uygulamasından 24 saat sonra BMSC-exos i.p. yolla verildi. Deney sonunda serum AST, ALT, ALP, MDA, CAT, GSH, SOD1, SIRT1 ve CRP düzeyleri değerlendirildi. Karaciğer dokuları histopatolojik olarak incelendi ve IL-2 ile IL-6 ekspresyonları immünohistokimyasal yöntemle araştırıldı. Bulgular: CP uygulaması serum AST, ALT ve LDH düzeylerinde anlamlı artışa neden oldu. BMSC-exos tedavisi sonrasında bu parametrelerde belirgin azalma saptandı. Oksidatif stres belirteci olan MDA düzeyleri CP grubunda anlamlı olarak yükselirken, BMSC-exos uygulaması sonrasında azaldı. Antioksidan savunma parametrelerinden CAT, GSH, SOD1 ve SIRT1 düzeylerinde CP grubunda azalma gözlenirken, tedavi sonrasında bu parametrelerde iyileşme belirlendi. Histopatolojik incelemelerde CP grubunda hepatosit dejenerasyonu, sinüzoidal dilatasyon, konjesyon ve inflamatuar hücre infiltrasyonu izlenirken, BMSC-exos tedavisinin bu değişiklikleri belirgin şekilde azalttığı görüldü. İmmünohistokimyasal değerlendirmede IL-2 ve IL-6 ekspresyonlarının CP grubunda arttığı, BMSC-exos uygulaması sonrasında ise azaldığı saptandı. Sonuç: BMSC-exos uygulaması, CP'ye bağlı hepatotoksisitenin azaltılmasında umut verici bir tedavi yaklaşımı olabilir. Anahtar Kelimeler: Siklofosfamid, karaciğer hasarı, mezenkimal kök hücre eksozomları, oksidatif stres.

makaleler.baslik: The Effectiveness of Prehabilitation on Surgical Outcomes in Pancreatic Surgery: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pankreas Cerrahisinde Prehabilitasyonun Cerrahi Sonuçlara Etkisi: Sistematik Derleme ve Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 12 çalışma ve 1841 hastayı kapsayan meta-analizde prehabilitasyon, toplam komplikasyonları (RR 0,85; %95 CI 0,76-0,95) ve DGE'yi (RR 0,77; %95 CI 0,63-0,94) belirgin azalttı. Sadece 2 RCT içeren analizde de bu etkiler korundu (komplikasyon RR 0,53; DGE RR 0,34). Yatış süresi, mortalite ve POPF üzerinde anlamlı fark görülmedi.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Pancreatic surgery is associated with high rates of postoperative complications. Prehabilitation has emerged as a key preoperative strategy to optimize patients' physiological status prior to surgery. However, its specific role and efficacy in pancreatic surgery are not well established. This review aimed to examine the impact of multimodal prehabilitation interventions on key postoperative outcomes in patients undergoing elective pancreatic resection.
METHODS: This systematic review and meta-analysis was reported in accordance with PRISMA guidelines. MEDLINE, Embase, Web of Science and the Cochrane Library were searched. RCTs and comparative observational studies evaluating prehabilitation programs in adult patients undergoing pancreatic surgery were included. Meta-analyses were performed for all studies combined, and separately for RCTs only and observational studies only.
RESULTS: Twelve studies (two RCTs and 10 comparative observational studies) comprising 1841 patients were included. The RCT-only analysis was based on 128 patients. Prehabilitation was associated with significantly fewer overall postoperative complications (RR 0.85; 95% CI, 0.76-0.95; p = 0.005) and delayed gastric emptying (DGE) events (RR 0.77; 95% CI, 0.63-0.94; p = 0.01). In the RCT-only analysis, effects remained significant for overall complications (RR 0.53; 95% CI, 0.36-0.77; p = 0.001) and DGE (RR 0.34; 95% CI, 0.13-0.87; p = 0.02). However, there was no significant effect on length of stay (p = 0.10), major complications (p = 0.11), mortality (p = 0.26), readmission (p = 0.30) and postoperative pancreatic fistula (p = 0.83).
CONCLUSION: This review suggests a potential morbidity benefit of prehabilitation for overall complications and delayed gastric emptying (DGE), but the evidence is derived predominantly from observational data, with only two small RCTs; these findings are exploratory and require confirmation in adequately powered randomized trials.

makaleler.baslik: Long-Term Pancreatic Function, Reconstruction Durability, and Disease Control After Pancreas-Preserving Total Duodenectomy: Systematic Review and Single-Arm Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pankreas Koruyucu Total Duodenektomi Sonrası Uzun Dönem Sonuçlar: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 9 retrospektif kohortta (199 hasta, %86,4 FAP) PPTD incelenmiştir. Genel morbidite %64,7, majör morbidite %40,3, CR-POPF %27,5, biliyopankreatik kaçak %32,1 saptanmıştır. Erken mortalite 1 hasta bildirilmiştir. Uzun dönemde yeni diyabet ve ekzokrin yetmezlik %1,8, geç pankreatit %18,3 ve jejunal adenom %25,8 bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Pancreas-preserving total duodenectomy (PPTD) enables complete duodenal resection while preserving the pancreatic head in selected benign or premalignant disease. Long-term pancreatic function, reconstruction durability, and disease control after PPTD remain incompletely defined.
METHODS: We performed a PRISMA-compliant systematic review and single-arm meta-analysis registered in PROSPERO. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched through June 29, 2026. Institutional reports were grouped into cohort families to avoid patient duplication. Pooled proportions were estimated using inverse-variance logit models or generalized linear mixed models for prespecified outcomes with zero events. Risk of bias and certainty of evidence were assessed using ROBINS-I and GRADE.
RESULTS: Nine independent retrospective cohorts comprising 199 patients were included; 86.4% had familial adenomatous polyposis, and follow-up ranged from 20 to 125 months. Overall postoperative morbidity was 64.7% (95% CI, 51.5-76.0), major morbidity 40.3% (28.5-53.3), biliopancreatic anastomotic leakage 32.1% (23.5-42.1), and clinically relevant postoperative pancreatic fistula 27.5% (17.5-40.5). One early postoperative death was reported. New-onset diabetes and exocrine pancreatic insufficiency were each reported in 1.8%, and subsequent pancreatic resection occurred in 3.6%. Late pancreatitis occurred in 18.3%, recurrent pancreatitis in 12.4%, biliopancreatic stenosis in 5.0%, cholangitis in 3.3%, and late reoperation in 9.5%. Endoscopic surveillance was documented in 83.3%; jejunal adenomas occurred in 25.8%, additional jejunal resection in 4.8%, jejunal cancer in 2.5%, and gastric cancer in 4.6%. Certainty of evidence was very low across outcomes.
CONCLUSIONS: PPTD is associated with substantial perioperative morbidity but low early mortality, with infrequently reported long-term endocrine and exocrine impairment, although no study applied functional testing. Late pancreatitis and metachronous jejunal disease remain clinically relevant and support lifelong endoscopic surveillance. Evidence remains limited to small retrospective series and does not establish comparative superiority over other surgical strategies.

makaleler.baslik: Postoperative Pain Treatment After Pancreatic Surgery: A Systematic Review With Meta-Analyses and Trial Sequential Analyses.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pankreas Cerrahisi Sonrası Postoperatif Ağrı Tedavisi: Sistematik Derleme ve Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 18 RCT ve 1468 hastanın incelendiği meta-analizde, postoperatif 2. günde COX inhibitörleri istirahat ağrı skorunu azalttı. Epidural analjezi ile daha az invaziv stratejiler (paravertebral blok, yara yeri infiltrasyonu) postoperatif 1-2. günlerde benzer ağrı kontrolü sağlarken, 3. günde daha az invaziv yöntemlerde ağrı skorları daha düşüktü.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Major pancreatic surgery is associated with significant postoperative pain that impairs early mobilisation and recovery. ERAS guidelines for pancreaticoduodenectomy recommend multimodal opioid-sparing analgesia, with a strong recommendation for epidural analgesia and continuous wound infiltration as an alternative. Other techniques may be beneficial, but their efficacy and safety remain uncertain.
OBJECTIVE: To investigate the efficacy and adverse events of different postoperative analgesic modalities for patients undergoing total pancreatectomy, pancreaticoduodenectomy and distal pancreatectomy.
DATABASES AND DATA TREATMENT: This PROSPERO-registered systematic review (ID CRD420251085003) reported in accordance with the PRISMA guidelines. A search for randomised controlled trials was conducted in Medline, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials and Embase. Meta-analyses were performed in Review Manger, risk of bias was assessed with RoB 2, trial sequential analyses were performed, and the certainty of evidence was evaluated using GRADE.
RESULTS: Eighteen RCTs comprising 1468 patients were included, and 10 meta-analyses were performed. Meta-analyses demonstrated reduced pain scores at rest on postoperative day (POD) two with COX-inhibitors compared with placebo/no intervention. Pain scores were similar when comparing epidural analgesia with less invasive strategies (paravertebral block and wound infiltration) on POD1-POD2, but lower with the less invasive techniques on POD3. Meta-analyses were small, and GRADE recommendations ranged from very low to low.
CONCLUSIONS: The available evidence was insufficient to establish the superiority of any single analgesic strategy after major pancreatic surgery. Several analgesic strategies, including COX inhibitors, paravertebral block and continuous wound infiltration, showed promising results. Larger RCTs are needed to provide stronger evidence-based recommendations.
SIGNIFICANCE STATEMENT: Epidural analgesia has long been considered the gold standard for treatment of postoperative pain after major pancreatic surgery. The present review adds to the field by demonstrating that less invasive strategies as continuous wound infiltration and paravertebral block provide comparable pain scores in the first postoperative days, with a significantly lower score on postoperative day three. This supports positioning less invasive strategies as viable alternatives to epidural analgesia.

makaleler.baslik: International multicenter validation of an 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography/computed tomography maximum standardized uptake value 4.0 threshold to guide surgical selection in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma following neoadjuvant therapy.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Neoadjuvan Tedavi Sonrası Pankreas Kanserinde Cerrahi Seçim İçin FDG-PET/BT SUVmax Eşiği
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 923 hastanın incelendiği çok merkezli retrospektif çalışmada, neoadjuvan sonrası SUVmax ≥4,0 daha kötü overall survival ile ilişkili bulundu (validasyon: HR 1,53; %95 CI 1,13-2,07). SUVmax ≥4,0 ve CA 19-9 >37 U/mL olan grupta 6 ayda erken nüks %32 saptandı ve yüksek SUVmax uzak nüksle ilişkiliydi.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: To determine whether a single post-neoadjuvant therapy fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography combined with computed tomography measurement and maximum standardized uptake value can guide surgical selection in anatomically resectable or borderline-resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Limitations of morphologic computed tomography because of neoadjuvant therapy-induced changes require decision-time biomarkers reflecting residual tumor biology.
METHODS: This international multicenter retrospective study analyzed 923 patients with resectable or borderline-resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma who underwent neoadjuvant therapy, preoperative fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography combined with computed tomography, and pancreatectomy. An outcome-based post-neoadjuvant therapy maximum standardized uptake value threshold of 4.0 was derived from a temporal derivation cohort (2017-2019; n = 413) and validated without reoptimization in an independent cohort (2020-2021; n = 510). The end points were overall survival, recurrence-free survival, early recurrence within 6 months, and first-failure pattern.
RESULTS: Post-neoadjuvant therapy maximum standardized uptake value ≥4.0 was independently associated with inferior overall survival (derivation: hazard ratio, 1.86; 95% confidence interval, 1.40-2.45; validation: hazard ratio, 1.53; 95% confidence interval, 1.13-2.07). Combining maximum standardized uptake value (≥4.0 vs <4.0) with post-neoadjuvant therapy carbohydrate antigen 19-9 (>37 vs ≤37 U/mL) yielded clear stepwise separation of recurrence-free survival and overall survival. Maximum standardized uptake value ≥4.0 modestly predicted early recurrence within 6 months (area under the curve, 0.65), whereas a "double-positive" rule (maximum standardized uptake value ≥4.0 and carbohydrate antigen 19-9 >37 U/mL) increased specificity (0.83) with lower sensitivity (0.42), with 32% early recurrence within 6 months in this subgroup. A high maximum standardized uptake value was associated with distant but not margin-related failure.
CONCLUSION: A post-neoadjuvant therapy maximum standardized uptake value threshold of 4.0 defined a reproducible, single-time-point metabolic criterion that complemented carbohydrate antigen 19-9 level to enable biology-guided surgical selection in anatomically resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.

makaleler.baslik: Computed tomography-based embryologic compartment classification provides prognostic stratification in pancreatic head ductal adenocarcinoma.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pankreas başı kanserinde BT bazlı embriyolojik kompartman sınıflandırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Kuratif rezeksiyon yapılan 173 pankreas başı PDAC hastasında BT bazlı dorsal-confined (DC) tümörlerde ortanca genel sağkalım 61,5 ay iken non-DC grupta 25,2 ay saptanmıştır (p=0,0016). DC lokalizasyonu bağımsız iyi sağkalım göstergesidir (HR 0,546; %95 CI 0,323-0,920; p=0,0178).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: Pancreatic head PDAC arises within embryologically distinct dorsal and ventral compartments. We investigated whether CT-based embryologic compartment classification identifies prognostically distinct subgroups after curative-intent resection.
METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 173 patients who underwent curative-intent resection for pancreatic head PDAC between 2009 and 2024. On preoperative contrast-enhanced CT, the embryologic boundary was approximated by a line connecting the anterior edge of the intrapancreatic common bile duct and the center of the portal vein-superior mesenteric vein axis. Tumors were classified as dorsal-confined (DC), dorsal-predominant (DP), ventral-predominant (VP), or ventral-confined (VC).
RESULTS: The cohort comprised 44 DC, 64 DP, 53 VP, and 12 VC tumors. Overall survival differed significantly among the four groups (p = 0.0078), with DC tumors showing better survival than DP, VP, and VC tumors. Because survival did not differ significantly among DP, VP, and VC tumors, these were combined as non-DC tumors. Median overall survival was 61.5 months in DC and 25.2 months in non-DC tumors (p = 0.0016). DC location remained independently associated with favorable overall survival in the preoperative model (HR, 0.546; 95% CI, 0.323-0.920; p = 0.0178) and in the model including selected postoperative clinicopathological and treatment factors (HR, 0.578; 95% CI, 0.341-0.980; p = 0.0345). This association remained significant in analyses restricted to anatomically resectable disease.
CONCLUSIONS: CT-based embryologic compartment classification identified DC tumors as a favorable subgroup and may provide complementary information for preoperative risk stratification.

tez.baslik: Pankreas kanseri nedeniyle pankreatikoduodenektomi uygulanan hastalarda dren yıkamasının postoperatif komplikasyonlar üzerine etkisi
tez.baslik_tr: Pankreatikoduodenektomi sonrası dren yıkamasının postoperatif komplikasyonlara etkisi
tez.kisa_ozet: Pankreatikoduodenektomi yapılan 130 hastanın retrospektif tezi çalışmasında, sürekli dren irrigasyonu yapılan grupta (n=40) Grade A POPF kontrol grubuna (n=90) göre anlamlı düşük saptanmıştır. Klinik anlamlı POPF (Grade B/C), DGE, PPH, reoperasyon ve mortalite açısından gruplar arasında fark izlenmemiştir.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışmanın temel amacı, pankreatikoduodenektomi sonrası uygulanan sürekli dren irrigasyonunun klinik anlamlı pankreatik fistül, intraabdominal apse, postpankreatektomi kanaması (PPH), yeniden girişim ihtiyacı, gecikmiş gastrik boşalma (DGE), yoğun bakım ihtiyacı, uzamış hastane yatışı ve mortalite üzerine etkisini değerlendirmektir. Ayrıca sürekli dren irrigasyonunun postoperatif dren sıvısı örneklemeleri ve hematolojik değerler üzerine etkisi ile özellikle POPF açısından yüksek risk faktörüne sahip hastalardaki etkinliği incelenmiştir. Yöntem: Ocak 2023 ile Aralık 2025 tarihleri arasında İzmir Kâtip Çelebi Üniversitesi Atatürk Eğitim ve Araştırma Hastanesi Genel Cerrahi Kliniği'nde pankreas kanseri nedeniyle pankreatikoduodenektomi uygulanan 130 hasta retrospektif olarak değerlendirildi. Hastalar standart dren yönetimi uygulanan kontrol grubu (n=90) ve sürekli dren irrigasyonu uygulanan irrigasyon grubu (n=40) olarak iki gruba ayrıldı. Demografik özellikler, perioperatif değişkenler, postoperatif laboratuvar bulguları, dren parametreleri ve komplikasyonlar karşılaştırıldı. Bulgular: Gruplar demografik özellikler ve komorbiditeler açısından benzerdi. İrrigasyon grubunda vücut kitle indeksi daha yüksek bulundu. Grade A POPF irrigasyon grubunda kontrol grubuna göre anlamlı olarak daha düşük saptanırken, klinik anlamlı POPF (Grade B/C), DGE, PPH, safra kaçağı, intraabdominal apse, perkütan girişim, reoperasyon, yoğun bakım ve hastanede yatış süresi ile mortalite açısından gruplar arasında anlamlı fark bulunmadı. Dren amilaz düzeyleri açısından üçüncü ve beşinci gün ölçümlerinde gruplar arasında anlamlı fark saptanmazken, dren bilirubin ve trigliserid düzeyleri irrigasyon grubunda daha düşük bulundu. Yüksek riskli hasta alt grup analizlerinde klinik anlamlı POPF oranları irrigasyon grubunda daha düşük olmakla birlikte istatistiksel anlamlılık saptanmadı. Sonuç: Sürekli dren irrigasyonu, pankreatikoduodenektomi sonrası Grade A pankreatik fistül gelişimini azaltmış ve postoperatif dren biyokimyasal parametreleri üzerine olumlu etkiler göstermiştir. Ancak klinik anlamlı pankreatik fistül ve diğer majör postoperatif komplikasyonlar açısından anlamlı üstünlük gösterilememiştir. Sürekli dren irrigasyonu fistül gelişimini azaltabilecek bir yöntemdir. Dren irrigasyonunun etkinliğinin ortaya konulabilmesi için daha geniş örneklemli prospektif randomize çalışmalara ihtiyaç vardır.

makaleler.baslik: Efficacy of indocyanine green (ICG) angiography in reducing postoperative complications in oesophagectomy: systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Özofajektomide ICG Anjiyografinin Anastomotik Kaçak Üzerine Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 2845 hastayı içeren 23 çalışmanın yer aldığı meta-analizde, özofajektomide ICG kullanımı anastomotik kaçak oranlarında azalma ile ilişkili bulunmuştur (OR 0,44; p<0,001). Ayrıca kondükt nekrozu da ICG grubunda daha düşük saptanmıştır (OR 0,32; p=0,022).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Anastomotic leakage after oesophagectomy is common, and associated with significant morbidity and mortality. Indocyanine green (ICG) fluorescence angiography has emerged as a promising intraoperative adjunct for perfusion assessment at the anastomotic site. This study aims to assess the impact of ICG use on anastomotic leakage rates and postoperative outcomes.
METHODS: A PRISMA-compliant systematic search of Medline, PubMed, EMBASE, and the Cochrane Library was performed. The primary outcome was anastomotic leakage. Key secondary outcomes were conduit necrosis, mortality, and reoperation; all secondary outcomes were reported. The Risk Of Bias In Non-randomized Studies - of Interventions (ROBINS-I) and Risk of Bias 2 (RoB 2) tools were used for investigating risk of bias. Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) was used to assess certainty of evidence. A random-effects meta-analysis and meta-regression as well as subgroup and sensitivity analyses were performed.
RESULTS: From 902 identified studies, 23 met the inclusion criteria (including 4 RCTs; 2845 patients, of whom 1154 underwent ICG assessment). ICG use was associated with reduced anastomotic leakage rates (OR 0.44 (95% c.i. 0.29 to 0.65), P < 0.001; number needed to treat = 13) and conduit necrosis rates (OR 0.32 (95% c.i. 0.12 to 0.85), P = 0.022). Mortality (OR 1.43 (95% c.i. 0.69 to 2.97), P = 0.335), reoperation (OR 0.84 (95% c.i. 0.51 to 1.39), P = 0.500), severe anastomotic leakage, overall morbidity, readmission, operating time, and length of stay did not differ between groups. Certainty of evidence was low or very low across all outcomes (GRADE), predominantly driven by the observational study design of many of the studies.
CONCLUSION: Use of ICG appears to be associated with reduced anastomotic leak in oesophagectomy, although certainty of evidence is low. Assessment remains qualitative and operator-dependent.

makaleler.baslik: Endoscopic Classification of Fundoplication Integrity Predicts Pathologic Reflux: Development and Prospective Validation.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Fundoplikasyon Bütünlüğünün Endoskopik Sınıflandırılması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 122 hastanın dahil olduğu çalışmada, antireflü cerrahisi sonrası valv lokalizasyonu, bozulması ve hiatal açıklığa dayanan yeni bir endoskopik sınıflandırma geliştirilmiştir. Geliştirme ve validasyon kohortlarında patolojik reflüyü ayırt etme eğrileri sırasıyla 0,860 ve 0,870 AUC olarak bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: We aimed to validate individual endoscopic parameters against clinical and functional testing and to build a simple classification of fundoplication integrity.
SUMMARY BACKGROUND DATA: Endoscopy is the main tool to assess the gastroesophageal valve after antireflux surgery (ARS), but existing classifications are complex and have never been validated against objective pathophysiologic data.
METHODS: This was a single-center, two-phase cohort study of adults undergoing endoscopy, high-resolution manometry (HRM), and reflux monitoring after ARS. Retroflexed videoclips were reviewed blinded to functional results. In the development cohort (2018-2024), endoscopic parameters were tested against pathologic GERD (Lyon 2.0 criteria); those correlating with reflux were included in the classification and the population was stratified according to the number of impaired mechanisms (0-3). In the second phase, the classification was validated prospectively (2024-2026).
RESULTS: Of 122 patients, 73 formed the development and 49 the validation cohort. Three parameters were associated with pathologic GERD: intrathoracic valve, disrupted valve, and visible hiatus. Clinical, manometric, and reflux metrics worsened stepwise with the number of impaired mechanisms, and pathologic GERD rose from 11.8% to 37.5% to 85.7%. The new classification discriminated pathologic GERD with an area under the curve of 0.860 in the development and 0.870 in the validation cohort (0.869 overall).
CONCLUSIONS: A simple endoscopic classification based on valve location, disruption, and hiatal opening reliably identifies fundoplication failure and correlates with symptoms, manometric features, and reflux burden.

makaleler.baslik: Association between Oral Nutritional Supplement Intake and Postoperative Weight Loss in Older Patients After Gastrectomy: A Post-hoc Analysis of a Multicenter Randomized Trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Gastrektomi Sonrası Oral Beslenme Desteği ve Kilo Kaybı
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Gastrektomi geçiren 828 hastanın incelendiği multisentrik çalışmada, distal gastrektomi olan yaşlı hastalarda günde 300-400 kcal ONS alımı 3. ayda vücut ağırlığı kaybı yüzdesini kontrol grubuna göre azaltmıştır (%3,0'a karşı %7,0, p=0,0003). Total gastrektomi sonrası genç hastalarda da benzer bir yarar gözlenmiştir (%5,7'ye karşı %11,3, p=0,0003).
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: Body weight loss (BWL) remains a serious complication after gastrectomy, particularly in older patients who have reduced physiological reserve and are more vulnerable to postoperative nutritional decline. This post‑hoc exploratory analysis evaluated how oral nutritional supplement (ONS) intake was associated with postoperative BWL across age groups and surgical procedures.
METHODS: This study included 828 of the 1003 patients with gastric cancer undergoing gastrectomy in a multicenter phase III randomized controlled trial. The patients were classified into two groups: older (≥70 years) and younger (<70 years). The postoperative BWL up to 12 months was assessed based on age, amount of oral nutritional supplements (ONS), and surgical procedures (distal gastrectomy [DG] or total gastrectomy [TG]).
RESULTS: Among 362 older patients, those who underwent DG and received 300-400kcal/day of ONS showed lower percentage of body weight loss (%BWL) at 3 months than controls (3.0 ± 0.9% vs. 7.0 ± 0.6%, p = 0.0003). After TG, the 100-200kcal/day group showed a transient difference at 3 months. Among 466 younger patients, ONS intake ≥100kcal/day was associated with lower %BWL after DG in exploratory subgroup comparisons. After TG, 300-400kcal/day was associated with lower %BWL at 3 months than controls (5.7 ± 1.2% vs. 11.3 ± 0.6%, p = 0.0003). In the adjusted model including 640 complete cases, the ONS × age group interaction was small (p= 0.036), whereas the ONS × procedure interaction comparing TG with non-TG (DG and proximal gastrectomy) was not statistically significant (p= 0.681).
CONCLUSIONS: Higher actual ONS intake was associated with smaller short-term BWL in exploratory analyses; however, these findings do not support causal interpretation. The ONS × surgical procedure interaction was not statistically significant. Prospective studies should evaluate individualized or multimodal nutritional approaches and body composition outcomes.

makaleler.baslik: Comparison of laparoscopic and open gastrectomy in gastric cancer: a randomized clinical trial on sufficiency of lymph node dissection and perioperative outcomes.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Gastrik Kanserinde Laporoskopik ve Açık Gastrektominin Karşılaştırılması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 40 hastanın katıldığı tek merkezli RCT'de, laparoskopik ve açık gastrektomi arasında çıkarılan ortalama lenf düğümü sayısı benzer bulunmuştur (24,75'e karşı 25,5, p=0,222). Laparoskopik grupta daha az kanama (90 mL'ye karşı 128 mL, p<0,001) ve daha kısa hastanede kalış süresi (3,95 güne karşı 6,65 gün, p<0,001) bildirilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: To evaluate the oncological sufficiency and perioperative outcomes of laparoscopic versus open gastrectomy in patients with gastric adenocarcinoma, focusing on the sufficiency of lymph node dissection and short-term clinical results.
METHODS: This single-center, single-blind, randomized clinical trial included 40 patients with gastric adenocarcinoma, allocated equally to undergo either open or laparoscopic gastrectomy with standard D2 lymphadenectomy. The primary outcome was the total number of dissected lymph nodes. Secondary outcomes included operative time, intraoperative blood loss, postoperative complications, and length of hospital stay.
RESULTS: Both groups were comparable in demographic and baseline clinical characteristics. The mean number of dissected lymph nodes was similar between open (25.5 ± 1.67) and laparoscopic (24.75 ± 2.12) groups (p = 0.222), meeting oncologic adequacy criteria. Laparoscopic surgery resulted in significantly less blood loss (90.00 ± 13.82 mL vs. 128.00 ± 23.96 mL, p < 0.001) and shorter hospital stay (3.95 ± 0.68 days vs. 6.65 ± 0.93 days, p < 0.001), but required longer operative time (198.75 ± 26.25 min vs. 114.00 ± 18.93 min, p < 0.001). Postoperative complication rates were lower in the laparoscopic group (10.0% vs. 30.0%), though the difference was not statistically significant (p = 0.235).
CONCLUSION: Laparoscopic gastrectomy is a safe and effective alternative to open surgery for gastric cancer, achieving comparable lymphadenectomy with advantages in blood loss and recovery time. These findings support the oncological safety and perioperative benefits of the minimally invasive approach when performed by experienced surgeons.

makaleler.baslik: Neoadjuvant immunotherapy for locally advanced resectable gastric and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Lokal İleri Rezekte Edilebilir Mide ve GEJ Adenokarsinomunda Neoadjuvan İmmünoterapi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 20 çalışmayı kapsayan meta-analizde lokal ileri rezekte edilebilir mide ve GEJ adenokarsinomunda neoadjuvan/perioperatif ICI tedavisinin birleşik pCR oranı %22,8 (%95 CI 18,6-27,6) ve R0 rezeksiyon oranı %97,2 (%95 CI 94,0-98,7) saptandı. Postoperatif cerrahi komplikasyon oranı %26,2 (%95 CI 19,1-34,7) olarak gerçekleşti.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Neoadjuvant and perioperative immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)-based strategies are increasingly being investigated in locally advanced resectable gastric and gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) adenocarcinoma, but the overall efficacy and safety of these approaches remain uncertain. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate pathological response, surgical outcomes, radiological response, and treatment-related safety of ICI-containing preoperative regimens in this setting.
METHODS: A systematic search of PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Cochrane CENTRAL, Web of Science, and Scopus was conducted from 2014 to 2026. Google Scholar was also searched as a supplementary source for gray literature and citation tracking. Studies evaluating neoadjuvant or perioperative ICI-based therapy in adults with locally advanced resectable gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma were included. Pooled estimates for pathologic complete response (pCR), major pathologic response (MPR), objective response rate (ORR), R0 resection, and safety outcomes were calculated using random-effects models.
RESULTS: Twenty studies were included. The pooled pCR rate was 22.8% (95% c.i. 18.6% to 27.6%), MPR was 49.5% (95% c.i. 41.8% to 57.1%), ORR was 60.6% (95% c.i. 42.0% to 76.6%), and R0 resection was 97.2% (95% c.i. 94.0% to 98.7%). The pooled rates of grade 3 or higher adverse events, immune-related adverse events, and postoperative surgical complications were 24.0% (95% c.i. 15.6% to 35.2%), 23.2% (95% c.i. 15.4% to 33.5%), and 26.2% (95% c.i. 19.1% to 34.7%), respectively.
CONCLUSION: Neoadjuvant or perioperative ICI-based therapy is associated with encouraging pathological response and high R0 resection rates in locally advanced resectable gastric and GEJ adenocarcinoma. However, the available evidence is limited by substantial clinical heterogeneity and immature survival data. Larger randomized studies with longer follow-up are needed to confirm long-term oncologic benefit and better define optimal patient selection.

tez.baslik: Mide kanseri cerrahisinde rezeksiyon genişliği ve batına giriş yönteminin belirlenmesi üzerinde etkili olan demografik, klinik ve cerrahi etkenlerin belirlenmesi
tez.baslik_tr: Mide Kanseri Cerrahisinde Rezeksiyon Genişliği ve Batına Giriş Yöntemi
tez.kisa_ozet: Mide kanseri cerrahisi geçiren 509 hastanın incelendiği tez çalışmasında 129 açık subtotal, 138 açık total, 169 laparoskopik total ve 73 laparoskopik subtotal gastrektomi değerlendirilmiştir. Batına giriş yönteminin histopatolojik açıdan anlamlı fark yaratmadığı, rezeksiyon genişliğinin ise histopatolojik verilerle ilişkili olduğu görülmüştür.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışmanın amacı mide kanseri sebebiyle ameliyat olmuş hastaların demografik ve laboratuvar sonuçlarının klinik olarak incelenerek, rezeksiyon genişliği ve batına giriş yönteminin ideal olarak belirlenmesinde etkili olabilecek verilerin ortaya konmasını sağlamaktır Materyal ve Metot: Merkezimizde mide kanseri sebebiyle onkolojik cerrahi uygulanan 509 hastanın cinsiyeti, histopatolojik verileri, ameliyat öncesi ve sonrası biyokimya, tam kan sayımı ve tümör marker değerleri incelendi. Elde edilen veriler açık cerrahi ve laparoskopik cerrahi ile total gastrektomi ve subtotal gastrektomi uygulanan hastalar için ayrı ayrı değerlendirilerek ideal cerrahi batına giriş yöntemi ve cerrahi rezeksiyon genişliği için etkili olan faktörler tespit edilmeye çalışıldı. Bulgular: Çalışmamıza toplam 509 mide kanseri sebebiyle onkolojik cerrahi yapılan birey dahil edilmiştir. Hasta grubumuzun 129' una Açık Subtotal Gastrektomi (ASG), 138' ine Açık Total Gastrektomi (ATG), 169' una Laparoskopik Total Gastrektomi (LTG), 73' üne Laparoskopik Subtotal Gastrektomi (LSG) uygulanmıştır. Yapılan analizlerde batına girme yönteminin aynı rezeksiyon genişliği ile yapılan açık cerrahiden anlamlı farkının olmadığı fakat rezeksiyon genişliğinin histopatolojik veriler açısından anlamlı olduğu görülmüştür. Sonuç: Deneyimli bir ekip ve doğru bir cerrahi yöntem kullanıldığında batına girme yönteminin hasta açısından klinik anlamda bir farkının olmaması sebebiyle mide kanseri cerrahisinde laparoskopik yöntemin hastanın mevcut halinin el vermesi durumunda öncelikli olarak tercih edilmesi ve mide kanseri cerrahisinde olumlu sonuç alabilmek için rezeksiyon genişliğinin guidelinelara uygun şekilde belirlenmesi doğru olacaktır. Bu konu ile ilgili Türkiye genelinde daha fazla çalışma ile kendi sonuçlarımızı oluşturmamız ve Dünya literatürü ile kıyaslayabilmemiz gerekmektedir. Anahtar Kelimeler: Mide kanseri, Laparoskopik cerrahi, Gastrektomi

makaleler.baslik: Type 2 Diabetes Relapse after Roux-en-Y Gastric Bypass and Sleeve Gastrectomy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: RYGB ve SG Sonrası Tip 2 Diyabet Nüksü Meta-Analizi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 9 çalışmada toplam 24.228 hastanın (9.674 SG, 14.554 RYGB) incelendiği meta-analizde T2DM nüks riski karşılaştırılmıştır. SG ile karşılaştırıldığında RYGB, T2DM nüks riskinde anlamlı düşüşle ilişkili bulunmuştur (HR 0,67; %95 CI 0,59-0,76; p<0,0001 ve OR 0,63; %95 CI 0,52-0,76; p<0,0001).
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) remission after bariatric surgery may not be durable, and relapse after initial remission is an increasingly important outcome. This systematic review and meta-analysis compared the risk of T2DM relapse after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB) versus sleeve gastrectomy (SG) in patients with obesity and T2DM who achieved postoperative remission.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception to April 20, 2026. Eligible studies included adults with obesity and preoperative T2DM who underwent primary RYGB or SG and reported T2DM relapse after remission. Hazard ratios (HRs) and odds ratios (ORs) were pooled separately using random-effects models. Study quality was assessed using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale or Cochrane risk of bias tool.
RESULTS: Nine studies comprising 11 cohorts and 24,228 patients were included; 9,674 underwent SG and 14,554 underwent RYGB. The mean age was 49.5 years, 31.4% were male, the mean BMI was 47.7 kg/m², and the mean T2DM duration was 5.7 years. Compared with SG, RYGB was associated with a significantly lower risk of T2DM relapse in HR-based analyses (HR, 0.67; 95% CI, 0.59-0.76; P < 0.0001; I² = 23.1%) and OR-based analyses (OR, 0.63; 95% CI, 0.52-0.76; P < 0.0001; I² = 0%). Subgroup analysis, sensitivity analysis, and publication-bias analysis supported the robustness of the findings.
CONCLUSIONS: This systematic review and meta-analysis suggests that RYGB was associated with a lower risk of T2DM relapse after initial remission than SG. However, given the predominantly retrospective nature of the available evidence, these findings should be interpreted cautiously and require confirmation in well-designed prospective studies.

makaleler.baslik: Effect of Study Design on the Conclusions of Randomized Clinical Trials: Systematic Review and Meta-analyses on Sleeve Gastrectomy vs. Roux-en-Y Gastric Bypass on Weight Loss Outcomes after Metabolic Bariatric Surgery.
makaleler.baslik_tr: SG ile RYGB Arasındaki Kilo Kaybı Sonuçlarında Çalışma Tasarımının Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 975 hastayı kapsayan 4 RCT'nin sistematik derlemesinde 5 yıllık kilo kaybı sonuçları incelenmiştir. RYGB grubunda SG'ye kıyasla %EWL 8,5 puan (%95 CI 5,4-11,6) ve %TWL 3,6 puan (%95 CI 2,4-4,9) daha yüksek bulunmuştur. Sonuçların yorumlanması hedeflenen hipotez tasarımına bağlıdır.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Only a few randomized clinical trials (RCTs) have reported 5-year outcomes of sleeve gastrectomy (SG) and Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB) and they have used different study designs based on various hypothesis frameworks, including superiority, equivalence, and noninferiority. The aim of this study was to highlight the impact of study design on the interpretation of 5-year weight loss outcomes of SG versus RYGB.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase and Cochrane databases were searched for RCTs comparing 5-year weight loss between SG and RYGB with follow-up rate exceeding 70% using percentage excess weight loss (%EWL) or percentage total weight loss (%TWL) through January 20, 2026. The revised Cochrane risk-of-bias tool for randomized trials (RoB 2) was used to assess the risk of bias. A pooled synthesis of weight loss was performed using a fixed-effects model and unstandardized mean differences were used to measure the effect size.
RESULTS: Four European studies met the inclusion criteria with a total of 975 patients: two superiority trials and two equivalence trials. The risk of bias was assessed to be low in all four studies. The pooled estimates indicate that %EWL was 8.5 (95%CI 5.4 to 11.6) and %TWL 3.6 (95%CI 2.4 to 4.9) percentage points higher in RYGB compared with SG.
CONCLUSIONS: The results across the four studies were highly consistent showing greater weight loss after RYGB compared with SG. Whether this difference should be interpreted as clinically relevant or whether the procedures may be considered equivalent depends on the predefined hypothesis.

makaleler.baslik: Redefining surgical outcomes after metabolic and bariatric surgery: an American Society for Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery narrative literature review of composite response metrics and body composition.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Metabolik ve Bariatrik Cerrahi Sonrası Cerrahi Sonuçların Yeniden Tanımlanması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: ASMBS derlemesinde, bariatrik cerrahi sonuçlarının yalnızca kilo ve BMI ile değerlendirilmesinin yetersiz olduğu vurgulanmıştır. BAROS, BQLI ve Swiss-Finnish gibi kompozit ölçütler ile vücut kompozisyonu analizlerinin kullanımı önerilmektedir. Bariatrik cerrahiye yanıt multidisipliner ve hasta odaklı ölçütlerle değerlendirilmelidir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Traditional assessment of response to metabolic and bariatric surgery (MBS) has relied predominantly on weight-based and body mass index (BMI)‑based outcomes. However, these measures, which are important to patients, fail to capture important dimensions of treatment response, including changes in body composition, obesity-related diseases, and health-related quality of life.
OBJECTIVES: To evaluate emerging approaches that incorporate composite response metrics and body composition assessment as outcome measures after MBS, complementing weight and BMI changes, which may not fully capture clinically meaningful improvements.
SETTING: Narrative review conducted by the ASMBS Clinical Issues Committee.
METHODS: A narrative review of the current literature was conducted to examine composite outcome measures after MBS and body composition changes.
RESULTS: BMI and conventional weight-based outcomes have limitations in assessing response to MBS and may systematically misclassify outcomes across patient populations. Composite measures such as the Bariatric Analysis and Reporting Outcome System, Bariatric Quality of Life Index, and Swiss-Finnish Bariatric Metabolic Outcome Score integrate multiple dimensions of response, including weight loss, improvements in obesity-related disease, complications, and health-related quality of life. Furthermore, body composition assessment provides clinically meaningful information regarding changes in fat mass, visceral adiposity, lean tissue, and bone mineral density that are not captured by BMI or body weight alone.
CONCLUSIONS: Response to MBS should not be defined solely by weight or BMI change from baseline. A multidimensional framework incorporating composite outcome measures, patient-reported outcomes, and body composition provides a more comprehensive and patient-centered evaluation of MBS outcomes. Future research should focus on standardizing these measures and evaluating their feasibility for integration into routine clinical practice and outcomes reporting.

makaleler.baslik: Preop​erative Frailty and Adverse Outcomes after Metab​olic and Bariatric Surgery: a Systematic Review of Prognostic Evidence.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Metabolik ve Bariatrik Cerrahi Öncesi Kırılganlık ve Olumsuz Sonuçlar
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 895 ile 693.066 hasta içeren 8 retrospektif çalışmanın sistematik derlemesinde preoperatif frailty incelenmiştir. Frailty, artmış 30 günlük mortalite (düzeltilmiş OR 3,23 ve 28,5) ve majör komplikasyonlarla (düzeltilmiş OR 1,24-1,99) ilişkili bulunmuştur. Kırılgan hastalarda mortalite SG sonrası %0,5-0,6, RYGB sonrası %1,0-1,1'dir.
makaleler.ozet: Preoperative frailty is increasingly recognized as a predictor of adverse outcomes following metabolic and bariatric surgery (MBS). We systematically reviewed eight retrospective studies with sample sizes ranging from 895 to 693,066 participants, although five analyzed overlapping MBSAQIP registry cohorts hence the number of unique patients cannot be precisely determined. Five frailty instruments were evaluated (mFI-11, bFI, BFS, mBFS and MSK-FI). Frailty was consistently associated with higher 30-day mortality (adjusted ORs 3.23 and 28.5) and major​ complications (categorical adjusted ORs 1.24-1.99; continuous mFI OR 39.7). Frailty was also associated with increased unplanned intensive care admission, prolonged hospital stay, non-home discharge, readmission, reoperation and suboptimal weight-loss outcomes. Among frail patients, reported mortality rates were 0.5-0.6% following SG and 1.0-1.1% following RYGB, although direct comparative estimates were unavailable. Despite generally consistent associations, certainty of evidence ranged from low to high across outcomes. Current evidence supports frailty assessment for perioperative risk stratification, although prospective validation of standardized instruments remains needed.

makaleler.baslik: Anatomy-Aware Effects of Biliopancreatic-Limb Length in Roux-en-Y Gastric Bypass: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: RYGB'de Biliyopankreatik Bacak Uzunluğunun Anatomiye Duyarlı Etkileri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 39 çalışmanın (14 RCT, 25 kohort) meta-analizinde BPL uzunluğunun etkileri değerlendirilmiştir. Sabit alimenter bacak uzatmasında 12 aylık HbA1c farkı -%0,18 (%95 CI -0,59 ila +0,23) saptanmıştır. İki sabit bacaklı RCT'de (146 hasta) %TWL farkı +0,36 puan (%95 CI -0,60 ila +1,32) bulunmuş olup BPL'nin tek başına etkisi gösterilememiştir.
makaleler.ozet: Trials labelled "long" biliopancreatic limb (BPL) test different Roux-en-Y gastric bypass configurations. We separated fixed-alimentary-limb BPL extension, reciprocal limb reallocation, distalization, and compound changes. The registered primary outcome was 12-month HbA1c in baseline type 2 diabetes. Eighty reports represented 39 studies (14 randomized trials, 25 cohorts). Primary HbA1c differences were - 0.18% points (95% CI - 0.59 to + 0.23) for fixed-limb extension and - 0.33 (- 0.60 to - 0.06) for reallocation; these classes were not pooled. Two fixed-limb trials (146 participants) yielded a secondary 12-month percentage total weight-loss difference of + 0.36 points (- 0.60 to + 1.32). Glycemic evidence remains sparse and configuration-specific. Fixed-limb evidence is inconsistent with a 5-point weight-loss gain but does not exclude smaller effects or identify the isolated BPL effect. KEY POINTS: • Only three of 14 RCTs tested fixed-AL BPL extension; one measured the CC. • Primary 12-month HbA1c could not be pooled within an anatomical class. • Fixed-total reallocation suggested a modest HbA1c package effect. • Allocation shifts and distalization cannot identify an isolated BPL effect.

tez.baslik: Sleeve gastrektomi yapılan obez hastalar ile normal vücut kitle indeksine sahip hastaların subkutan yağ dokusu ile serumlarındanesfatin-1 ve irisin değerlerinin karşılaştırılması
tez.baslik_tr: Obez Hastalarda Yağ Dokusu ve Serum İrisin ile Nesfatin-1 Düzeyleri
tez.kisa_ozet: 99 bireyin (50 obez, 49 normal BKİ) dahil edildiği kesitsel çalışmada, obez grupta serum ve subkutan yağ dokusu irisin ve nesfatin-1 düzeyleri kontrol grubuna göre anlamlı düşük bulunmuştur (p<0,05). Obez grupta preoperatif serum irisin düzeyi ile VKİ arasında orta düzeyde pozitif korelasyon izlenmiştir (r=0,457; p=0,016).
tez.ozet: Giriş: Obezite, yalnızca enerji fazlalığından kaynaklanan bir durum değil, çok yönlü nörohormonal ve metabolik bozulmalarla seyreden kronik bir hastalıktır. Bu süreçte adipoz dokunun endokrin fonksiyonlarında meydana gelen değişiklikler, hastalığın ilerleyişinde kritik rol oynamaktadır. Özellikle irisin (FNDC5 kökenli bir myokin) ve nesfatin-1 (NUCB2 kökenli anoreksijenik bir peptid), enerji metabolizması, iştah düzenlenmesi ve glikoz homeostazındaki rolleri nedeniyle obezite fizyopatolojisinde giderek daha fazla önem kazanmaktadır. Bu bağlamda irisin ve nesfatin-1 düzeylerinin hem serumda hem de yağ dokusunda değerlendirilmesi, obezitede hormonal yanıtın daha bütüncül şekilde anlaşılmasına katkı sağlamaktadır. Amaç: Bu çalışmanın amacı, obez ve normal BKİ'ye sahip bireylerde irisin ve nesfatin-1 düzeylerini hem serumda hem de subkutan yağ dokusunda değerlendirerek bu hormonların obezite ile ilişkisini ortaya koymak ve elde edilen bulguları antropometrik ve metabolik parametrelerle ilişkilendirmektir. Materyal ve Metod: Bu kesitsel çalışma kapsamında toplam 99 birey (50 obez, 49 normal BMI) değerlendirildi. Çalışmaya dahil edilen tüm bireylerin serum irisin ve nesfatin-1 düzeyleri ELISA yöntemi kullanılarak ölçüldü. Tüm katılımcılardan subkutan yağ dokusu örnekleri alındı ve doku irisin ile nesfatin-1 düzeyleri aynı kit protokolü ile analiz edildi. Katılımcıların BMI, yaş cinsiyet gibi parametreleri değerlendirildi. Obez grupta serum ve adipoz doku biyobelirteçlerinin antropometrik verilerle ilişkisi korelasyon analizi ile incelendi. Bulgular: Obez grupta serum irisin düzeyleri ile subkutan yağ dokusu irisin düzeyleri kontrol grubuna göre anlamlı derecede düşük bulundu (p<0,05). Benzer şekilde serum nesfatin-1 ve subkutan yağ dokusu nesfatin-1 düzeyleri de obez bireylerde kontrol grubuna kıyasla anlamlı olarak azalmıştı (p<0,05). Obez grup içerisinde yapılan korelasyon analizinde preoperatif serum irisin düzeyi ile vücut kitle indeksi arasında orta düzeyde pozitif korelasyon saptandı (r=0,457; p=0,016). Buna karşın obez grup içinde adipoz doku irisin, serum nesfatin-1 ve adipoz doku nesfatin-1 düzeyleri ile vücut kitle indeksi arasında anlamlı ilişki izlenmedi. Sonuç: Bu çalışma, obez bireylerde FNDC5/irisin ve NUCB2/nesfatin-1 akslarında belirgin bir baskılanma olduğunu göstermektedir. İrisin ve Nesfatin-1'in hem serum hem de yağ dokusu düzeylerinin düşük bulunması, obezitede adipoz doku endokrin fonksiyonunun bozulduğunu ve metabolik stresin hormon üretimini olumsuz etkilediğini düşündürmektedir. Obez grup kendi içinde değerlendirildiğinde preoperatif serum irisin düzeylerinin BKİ ile orta düzeyde pozitif korelasyon göstermesi, FNDC5/irisin sisteminin obezitenin belirli evrelerinde artmış yağ kütlesine sekonder salınımın arttığı veya kompansatuar bir yanıt oluşturabileceğini; ancak total irisin düzeylerinin kontrol grubu irisin düzeyinden düşük olması, obezitenin ilerleyen evrelerinde bu yanıtın sürdürülemediğini ve adipoz doku disfonksiyonunun baskın hale geldiğini düşündürmektedir. Genel olarak irisin ve nesfatin-1, obezitenin tanısal ve prognostik açıdan değerlendirilebileceği yeni nesil biyobelirteçler olarak dikkate değer görünmektedir. Bununla birlikte daha geniş örneklemli, çok merkezli ve longitudinal çalışmalarla bu bulguların desteklenmesi gerekmektedir. Anahtar Kelimeler: Obezite, İrisin, Nesfatin-1, FNDC5, NUCB2, Adipoz doku
