makaleler.baslik: Survival After Risk-Reducing Mastectomy in Patients With Pathogenic Variants in BRCA1 and BRCA2: A Network Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: BRCA1/2 Mutasyonlu Hastalarda Risk Azaltıcı Mastektomi Sonrası Sağkalım
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 7937 BRCA1/2 mutasyonlu kadını kapsayan 5 gözlemsel çalışmanın ağ meta-analizinde, risk azaltıcı mastektomi (RRM) tüm nedenlere bağlı mortaliteyi MRI taramasına göre düşürmüştür (HR 0,37; %95 CI 0,22-0,63). BRCA1 taşıyıcılarında RRM, meme kanserine özgü mortaliteyi azaltmıştır (HR 0,13; %95 CI 0,03-0,66).
makaleler.ozet:
IMPORTANCE: The independent survival benefit of risk-reducing mastectomy (RRM), separate from risk-reducing salpingo-oophorectomy (RRSO), remains uncertain among patients with pathogenic variants (PVs) in BRCA1 and BRCA2 genes.
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the association of RRM, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-based screening, and mammography alone with all-cause and breast cancer-specific mortality using RRSO-adjusted estimates.
DATA SOURCES: MEDLINE, Embase, and Web of Science were searched from January 1, 1990, to May 28, 2026. Search structures, subject headings, and keywords were tailored to each database.
STUDY SELECTION: Inclusion criteria were English-language prospective and retrospective observational studies of adult female patients with PV or likely PV in BRCA1 and BRCA2 who underwent RRM or breast cancer screening (MRI-based with or without mammography, or mammography alone), with RRSO excluded by design or adjusted for in multivariable analysis. Studies including females with prior breast or ovarian cancer were excluded.
DATA EXTRACTION AND SYNTHESIS: Study reporting followed Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses 2020 network meta-analysis extension. Two authors independently performed study selection, data extraction, and bias assessment using a risk-of-bias assessment tool (ROBINS-I V2) and a grading approach (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation [GRADE]). Frequentist random-effects network meta-analysis was performed with surface under the cumulative ranking curve (SUCRA) estimation. Sensitivity analysis was conducted for the BRCA1 cohort.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Primary outcome was all-cause mortality. Secondary outcome was breast cancer-specific mortality. All outcomes were analyzed and reported as hazard ratios (HRs) with corresponding 95% CIs.
RESULTS: Five observational studies with 7937 female patients (median [range] age, 35.9 [unreported] years to 43.4 [32.0-55.7] years) met the inclusion criteria. RRM was associated with lower all-cause mortality compared with MRI-based screening (HR, 0.37; 95% CI, 0.22-0.63) and mammography alone (HR, 0.16; 95% CI, 0.08-0.32). RRM was also associated with lower breast cancer-specific mortality compared with mammography alone (HR, 0.07; 95% CI, 0.01-0.44) but did not have significantly lower mortality than MRI-based screening (HR, 0.26; 95% CI, 0.05-1.35). In BRCA1-only analyses, RRM was associated with lower breast cancer-specific mortality compared with MRI-based screening (HR, 0.13; 95% CI, 0.03-0.66) and mammography alone (HR, 0.03; 95% CI, 0.00-0.15). SUCRA rankings indicated RRM had the highest likelihood of association with the lowest all-cause mortality (SUCRA value, 99.9%). Risk of bias was critical for 4 studies, and certainty of evidence was rated as very low for all 5 studies.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this systematic review and network meta-analysis of RRSO-adjusted analyses, RRM was associated with lower all-cause mortality compared with breast cancer screening among females with PVs in BRCA1 and BRCA2, with the greatest magnitude of association for breast cancer-specific mortality observed in BRCA1 PV carriers. These findings provide less confounded survival estimates to support individualized shared decision-making for RRM.

makaleler.baslik: The preventive strategies for chronic persistent postsurgical pain following breast cancer surgery: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Meme Kanseri Cerrahisi Sonrası Kronik Ağrıyı Önleme Stratejileri: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 27 RCT'yi içeren meta-analizde meme kanseri cerrahisi sonrası kronik ağrıyı (CPPP) önleyici farmakoterapi ve bölgesel blok stratejileri değerlendirilmiştir. Müdahale grubu, 3. ayda CPPP riskini %36 (RR 0,64; %95 CI 0,54-0,75; p<0,001) ve 6. ayda %40 (RR 0,60; %95 CI 0,41-0,87; p=0,007) oranında azaltmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Breast cancer is the most common malignant disease among women worldwide. With improved treatment, 5-year survival has increased leading to increasing number of survivors reporting chronic persistent post-surgical pain (CPPP). Hence this systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted to analyse preventive strategies in chronic persistent postsurgical pain following breast cancer surgery.
METHODS: Electronic databases were searched for randomized controlled trials that allocated patients undergoing breast cancer surgery to receive any intervention to prevent postsurgical pain. Data extraction was conducted by two reviewers and any discrepancy was resolved by third independent reviewer. The quality of study was assessed using the Pedro scale and risk of bias was assessed using Cochrane risk of bias. The primary outcomes of interest were patient-reported pain intensity as by the verbal rating scale (VRS), Visual analogue scale (VAS), and numerical rating scales (NRS), and incidence of chronic pain. This was assessed at 3 months and 6 months after the surgery. The association between the primary outcome and preventive strategies was analyzed using relative risk.
RESULTS: Twenty-seven studies were included. The intervention reduces the CPPP at 3-month by 36% as compared to the control group and this reduction was statistically significant [RR: 0.64: 0.54-0.75; P < 0.001; I2 = 24.2%]. The heterogeneity between them was quite low I2 = 24.2% with P = 0.158. Intervention group reduces the incidence of CPPP at 6 months by 40% which was also statistically significant [RR: 0.60: 0.41-0.87; P = 0.007; I2 = 36.9%; P = 0.125].
CONCLUSION: Either of the pain preventive strategies that is, pharmacotherapy and regional blocks led to a significant reduction in the incidence of CPPP at 3 months as well as 6 months.

makaleler.baslik: Prognosis and therapeutic choices for occult breast cancer in female patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Okült Meme Kanserinde Tedavi Seçenekleri ve Prognoz Meta-Analizi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Okült meme kanserli (T0N+M0) 6001 hastayı kapsayan 30 retrospektif çalışmanın meta-analizinde, 5 yıllık OS %90'dır. Mastektominin OS veya DFS üzerine anlamlı etkisi gösterilemezken, radyoterapi OS iyileşmesi ile ilişkili bulunmuştur (HR 0,60). N2-3 evresi kötü OS ile ilişkilidir (HR 6,10; %95 CI 2,19-16,95).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Occult breast cancer (OBC) is a rare subtype characterized by axillary lymph node (LN) metastasis without an identifiable primary breast lesion. Owing to its rarity, optimal management remains controversial. We performed a systematic review and meta-analysis to comprehensively evaluate the clinicopathological characteristics, prognosis, and treatment outcomes of female patients with OBC.
METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted using PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and the Cochrane Library to identify eligible studies published after 2000. Female patients with OBC (T0N+M0) were included. Primary outcomes were overall survival (OS) and disease-free survival (DFS), analyzed according to LN stage and treatment strategies.
RESULTS: Thirty retrospective studies involving 6,001 patients were included. The pooled treatment proportions were 30% for mastectomy plus axillary lymph node dissection (ALND), 42% for ALND alone, and 68% for radiotherapy (RT). The pooled proportions of N1, N2, and N3 disease were 62%, 20%, and 12%, respectively. The pooled 5-year and 8-year OS rates were 90% and 64%. Compared with N1 disease, patients with N2-3 disease had significantly worse OS (HR 6.10, 95% CI 2.19-16.95). Mastectomy was not significantly associated with OS or DFS. RT was associated with improved OS (HR 0.60), whereas no significant association with DFS was observed.
CONCLUSIONS: Female patients with OBC appear to have relatively favorable survival outcomes, while axillary nodal stage remains an important prognostic factor. Mastectomy was not associated with a clear survival advantage. RT appeared to be associated with improved OS; however, this finding should be interpreted cautiously because the available evidence was derived primarily from retrospective observational studies, and its effect on DFS remains uncertain. Further prospective studies are warranted to optimize treatment strategies for OBC.
TRIAL REGISTRATION PROSPERO: CRD42024535815.

makaleler.baslik: Comparative effectiveness of different physical therapies for axillary web syndrome after breast cancer surgery: A network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Meme Kanseri Cerrahisi Sonrası Aksiller Web Sendromunda Fizik Tedavi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Aksiller web sendromlu 1007 hastayı (14 RCT) içeren ağ meta-analizinde, manuel terapi + egzersiz + LLLT kombinasyonu ağrıyı ve omuz hareket açıklığını anlamlı düzeyde iyileştirmiştir (abduksiyon MD 59,51; fleksiyon MD 77,30). Manuel lenfatik drenaj + egzersiz ise kol fonksiyonunu en çok geliştiren yöntemdir (MD -19,01).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Axillary web syndrome (AWS) commonly occurs after breast cancer surgery, impairing shoulder range of motion (shoulder ROM) and upper limb function. Various physical therapies (PTs) have been applied in the management of AWS, but their comparative effectiveness remains unclear.
OBJECTIVES: This network meta-analysis compared multiple PTs for pain, shoulder ROM, and upper limb function in AWS patients.
DATA SOURCES: Embase, PubMed, CINAHL, Cochrane Library, Web of Science, CNKI, Wanfang, VIP, and CBM were systematically searched from inception to March 26, 2026.
METHODS: A Bayesian network meta-analysis was performed using a fixed-effects model (primary) and a random-effects model (sensitivity). Interventions were ranked by the surface under the cumulative ranking curve (SUCRA).
RESULTS: Fourteen RCTs (1007 patients, 11 interventions) were included. In fixed-effects analysis, soft tissue manual therapy (STMT) + therapeutic exercise + low-level laser therapy (LLLT) significantly reduced pain (SMD = -4.40, 95% Credible Interval (CrI): -5.52 to -3.28) and improved abduction (MD = 59.51, 95% CrI: 53.08-65.91) and flexion (MD = 77.30, 95% CrI: 66.30-88.29). MLD + therapeutic exercise showed the largest improvement in upper-limb disability (MD = -19.01, 95% CrI: -22.52 to -15.52). Ranking orders remained broadly consistent in sensitivity analyses, albeit with wider CrIs.
LIMITATIONS: Sparse network (11 interventions/14 studies), clinical heterogeneity, and model-dependent results (several CrIs crossing null in random-effects analysis) limit evidence certainty.
CONCLUSIONS: In the fixed-effects analysis, soft tissue manual therapy combined with therapeutic exercise and low-level laser therapy improved pain and shoulder range of movement, while manual lymphatic drainage and therapeutic exercise improved upper limb function. Further validation is warranted.
PROSPERO REGISTRATION NUMBER: CRD420251052737. CONTRIBUTION OF THE PAPER.

makaleler.baslik: Pre-treatment prediction of response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy in breast cancer patients using a nomogram based on findings from cone-beam breast computed tomography.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Neoadjuvan Kemoterapiye Yanıtı Öngören Koni Işınlı Meme BT Nomogramı
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Neoadjuvan kemoterapi alan 215 meme kanserli hastanın incelendiği çalışmada, pCR oranı %32,1 bulunmuştur. CBBCT bulguları ve biyobelirteçlerle oluşturulan nomogram pCR'yi yüksek başarım ile öngörmüştür (geliştirme AUC 0,841; doğrulama AUC 0,836). ER negatifliği ve HER-2 pozitifliği yanıtla ilişkili saptanmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Cone-beam breast computed tomography (CBBCT) can provide detailed information about breast tissue, but whether such information can help predict treatment response is unclear.
PURPOSE: To develop a nomogram based on findings from CBBCT as well as conventional clinical variables to predict pathological complete response (pCR) after neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) in patients with breast cancer.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Medical data were retrospectively analyzed for a consecutive series of women with breast cancer who underwent NAC followed within three months by resection surgery at our hospital between September 2019 and March 2022. Patients were randomized into a development cohort and validation cohort. A nomogram to predict pCR after chemotherapy was formulated based on univariable and multivariable logistic regression of pre-treatment data from the development cohort, and it was tested against data from the validation cohort. The performance of the nomogram was evaluated in terms of the area under receiver operating characteristic curves (AUC), calibration plots and decision curve analysis.
RESULTS: Of the 215 breast cancer patients in this study, 69 (32.1%) achieved pCR after NAC. Multivariable logistic regression of the development cohort linked such response independently to absence of estrogen receptor (ER) expression, expression of human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER-2), small tumor diameter and non-mass enhancement (NME) on CBBCT. The resulting nomogram predicted response with AUCs of 0.841 (95% CI: 0.78-0.90) in the development cohort (n = 150) and 0.836 (95% CI: 0.74-0.94) in the validation cohort (n = 65), and it was efficient against data from both cohorts based on calibration curves. Decision curve analysis suggested that the nomogram is clinically useful.
CONCLUSION: A nomogram incorporating molecular biomarkers and findings from CBBCT may help predict breast cancer patients more likely to respond to NAC.

tez.baslik: Meme başı areola koruyucu mastektomi + meme silikon implant ile rekonstrüksiyon yapılan olgularda geleneksel elektrokoter ile düşük termal diseksiyon koterin karşılaştırılması
tez.baslik_tr: Mastektomi ve Rekonstrüksiyonda Düşük Termal Diseksiyon Koteri ile Elektrokoter Karşılaştırması
tez.kisa_ozet: Meme başı areola koruyucu mastektomi ve silikon implant rekonstrüksiyonu yapılan hastaların incelendiği uzmanlık tezinde, düşük termal diseksiyon koteri ile geleneksel elektrokoter karşılaştırılmıştır. Düşük termal diseksiyon koteri kullanımı ameliyat süresi, dren miktarı, dren süresi ve postoperative ağrıyı anlamlı azaltmıştır (p<0,05).
tez.ozet: ÖZET Amaç: Cerrahi diseksiyon ve hemostaz için bistüri ve elektrokoter sık kullanılır. Düşük termal diseksiyon koteri, aralıklı yüksek frekanslı elektrik akımı ile daha düşük sıcaklıkta çalışarak kollateral termal hasarı azaltır. Bu çalışmada, meme başı areola koruyucu mastektomi (MBAKM) ve eş zamanlı silikon implantla rekonstrüksiyon uygulanan olgularda geleneksel elektrokoter ile düşük termal diseksiyon koterinin etkinliği karşılaştırılması amaçlanmıştır. Hastalar ve Yöntemler: Çalışmaya 1 Nisan 2023 – 31 Mayıs 2025 tarihleri arasında İstanbul Tıp Fakültesi, Genel Cerrahi Anabilim Dalı, Meme Cerrahisi seksiyonunda tek bir genel cerrah ve tek bir plastik, rekonstrüktif ve estetik cerrah tarafından MBAKM ve implant ile rekonstrüksiyonu yapılan hastalar dahil edildi. Hastalar düşük termal diseksiyon koter ve geleneksel elektrokoter olarak iki gruba ayrıldı. Demografik veriler, ameliyat süresi, dren miktarı ve süresi, ameliyat sonrası ağrı düzeyleri, hastanede yatış süresi ve komplikasyon oranları karşılaştırıldı. İstatistiksel analiz için bağımsız örneklem t-testi, Mann-Whitney U testi ve ki-kare testleri kullanılmış olup p 0.05). Sonuçlar: Düşük termal diseksiyon koter kullanımı MBAKM ve implant rekonstrüksiyon yapılan olgularda ameliyat süresi, dren miktarı, dren süresi ve ameliyat sonrası ağrıyı anlamlı olarak azaltmaktadır. Anahtar Kelimeler: Meme kanseri, Mastektomi, Meme rekonstrüksiyonu, Elektrocerrahi

makaleler.baslik: Small-bite compared with large-bite closure of midline laparotomy: meta-analysis of short- and long-term outcomes with trial sequential analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Orta Hat Laparotomilerde Küçük ve Büyük Isırık Fasyal Kapama Karşılaştırılması: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 10 RCT ve 2617 hastayı kapsayan meta-analizde, orta hat laparotomilerinde küçük ısırık tekniği insizyonel herni riskini %43 azaltmıştır (RR 0,57; %95 CI 0,39-0,82; p=0,003). Ayrıca SSI (RR 0,72) ve toplam komplikasyonlar (RR 0,76) azalmış, kapama süresi ise 4,82 dakika uzamıştır. Fayda 2 yılı aşan takipte de devam etmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Fascial closure after a midline laparotomy (ML) is a crucial step to avoid incisional hernia. This meta-analysis aimed to compare short- and long-term outcomes, including incisional hernia, of the small-bite versus large-bite closure techniques in ML.
METHODS: A PRISMA-compliant systematic review of RCTs comparing small-bite (5-mm bites/spacing) and large-bite (10-mm bites/spacing) techniques in ML closure was conducted. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Cochrane Central were searched from inception through April 2026 for eligible RCTs. The primary outcome was incisional hernia. Secondary outcomes included total complications, surgical-site infection (SSI), seroma, fascial dehiscence, closure time, and pain. Pairwise meta-analyses and trial sequential analyses (TSA) were performed.
RESULTS: Ten unique RCTs reported in 12 publications (2617 patients) were included. Among the five studies using standardized clinical and imaging assessment, small-bite closure reduced incisional hernia by 43% (risk ratio (RR) of 0.57 (95% c.i. 0.39 to 0.82) (P = 0.003, I2 = 44.1%), compared with an RR of 0.31 (95% c.i. 0.18 to 0.53) (P < 0.001, I2 = 0) when clinical assessment only was used). Across all eligible studies with follow-up >12 months, the pooled RR was 0.48 (95% c.i. 0.33 to 0.70). This benefit persisted on the analysis of studies with ≥24 months of follow-up (RR 0.56 (95% c.i. 0.36 to 0.89)). TSA demonstrated firm evidence for benefit despite not reaching the required information size. Small-bite closure was also associated with reduced SSI (RR 0.72) and total complications (RR 0.76), with no differences in seroma or fascial dehiscence. Closure time was slightly longer with small-bite closure (weighted mean difference 4.82 min), while pain scores were comparable.
CONCLUSION: The small-bite technique significantly reduced incisional hernia and postoperative complications after ML, with durable benefit extending beyond 2 years.

makaleler.baslik: Does the "switch the plane" strategy improve outcomes? Anterior vs. posterior repair for recurrence after prior inguinal hernia repair: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Nüks İnguinal Hernilerde Ön ve Arka Onarım Yaklaşımlarının Karşılaştırılması: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 35 çalışma ve 4.902 hastayı kapsayan meta-analizde, geçirilmiş ön onarım sonrası arka ve ön onarım arasında nüks açısından fark saptanmamıştır (OR 0,70; %95 CI 0,39-1,27). Ancak arka onarımda SSI riski daha düşük bulunmuştur (OR 0,24; %95 CI 0,07-0,79). RCT analizinde kronik ağrı da arka onarım lehinedir (OR 0,36).
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Recurrent inguinal hernia remains a common challenge in abdominal wall surgery. Current guidelines from the European Hernia Society recommend repairing recurrent inguinal hernias through the previously unoperated anatomical plane ("switch the plane" strategy), supporting a posterior repair after failed anterior repair. Although this strategy is widely adopted in clinical practice, the evidence supporting its superiority remains limited. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate surgical outcomes after recurrent inguinal hernia repair according to the anatomical plane of the index and subsequent repair.
METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted according to PRISMA guidelines. Databases including PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, and LILACS were searched for studies evaluating surgical repair of recurrent unilateral inguinal hernia. Comparative studies assessing posterior versus anterior repair were included for pooled comparative meta-analysis. Outcomes included hernia recurrence, chronic postoperative inguinal pain, surgical site infection (SSI), and seroma. Meta-analyses were performed in R studio using random-effects models, with results reported as odds ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI). Additional single-arm meta-analyses were conducted to estimate pooled outcome proportions among studies evaluating posterior repair after prior anterior repair and posterior repair after prior posterior repair.
RESULTS: After screening 14,197 records, 35 met the inclusion criteria and were included in the review. These studies comprised 4,902 patients, predominantly male (97.9%), with a mean age of 57.2 years. Six studies compared posterior versus anterior repair after prior anterior repair. Recurrence was assessed in six studies (869 patients; 63 events), with no statistically significant difference between approaches (OR 0.70, 95% CI 0.39-1.27; I²=7.5%). Chronic postoperative pain was assessed in five studies (722 patients; 92 events), with no statistically significant difference in the primary analysis (OR 0.47, 95% CI 0.22-1.00; I²=52.7%), although posterior repair was associated with significantly lower odds in the RCT-only sensitivity analysis (OR 0.36, 95% CI 0.16-0.81; I²=44.1%). SSI was assessed in five studies (604 patients; 14 events), with significantly lower odds following posterior repair (OR 0.24, 95% CI 0.07-0.79; I²=0%). Seroma was assessed in three studies (386 patients; 15 events), with no significant difference between approaches (OR 0.77, 95% CI 0.26-2.29; I²=0%). Among studies evaluating posterior repair after prior anterior repair, recurrence was assessed in seventeen studies (3,551 patients; 59 events), with a pooled rate of 2% (95% CI 0.01-0.03; I²=16.5%); chronic postoperative pain in fifteen studies (3,396 patients; 137 events), with a pooled rate of 3% (95% CI 0.01-0.06; I²=65.3%); SSI in fifteen studies (3,370 patients; 25 events), with a pooled rate of 1% (95% CI 0.00-0.02; I²=76.3%); and seroma in fourteen studies (3,339 patients; 110 events), with a pooled rate of 5% (95% CI 0.03-0.07; I²=74.5%). Among studies evaluating posterior re-repair after prior posterior repair, recurrence was assessed in eleven studies (316 patients; 8 events), with a pooled rate of 1% (95% CI 0.00-0.06; I²=0%); chronic postoperative pain in eight studies (224 patients; 19 events), with a pooled rate of 6% (95% CI 0.02-0.15; I²=0%); SSI in seven studies (231 patients; 3 events), with a pooled rate of 1% (95% CI 0.00-0.04; I²=0%); and seroma in eleven studies (316 patients; 21 events), with a pooled rate of 6% (95% CI 0.03-0.12; I²=34.8%). Only one study evaluated anterior repair following prior posterior repair, precluding quantitative synthesis.
CONCLUSION: No statistically significant difference in recurrence was identified between posterior and repeat anterior repair, while posterior repair was associated with significantly lower odds of SSI. Chronic postoperative pain also favored posterior repair, with a significant reduction observed in the RCT-only sensitivity analysis despite the primary analysis not reaching statistical significance. These findings support the guideline-recommended use of posterior repair following failed anterior repair. Posterior re-repair after prior posterior repair may also be feasible in selected cases, although the evidence remains predominantly observational. Evidence for anterior repair following prior posterior repair remains limited to a single study, precluding definitive conclusions regarding the complete "switch the plane" strategy.
STUDY REGISTRATION: A review protocol for this systematic review was registered at PROSPERO CRD420261375949.

makaleler.baslik: Comparison of Outcomes Between Men and Women Undergoing Ventral Hernia Repair.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Ventral Herni Onarımı Geçiren Kadın ve Erkek Hastaların Sonuçlarının Karşılaştırılması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 31.358 hastalık prospektif kohort çalışmasında, kadınların 30 günlük SSI (%2,6'ya karşı %1,7) ve SSO-PI (%3,6'ya karşı %2,5) oranları yüksek bulunmuştur (p<0,001). Kadın cinsiyeti SSI için bağımsız risk faktörüdür (OR 1,40). 3. yılda nüks oranı kadınlarda %20,9, erkeklerde %17,6 olarak gerçekleşmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
IMPORTANCE: Sex-based differences in ventral hernia repair (VHR) outcomes remain incompletely characterized.
OBJECTIVE: To compare short-term clinical outcomes, recurrence through 3 years, and patient-reported outcomes between female and male patients undergoing VHR.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This cohort study included patients undergoing VHR from January 2012 through December 2023, with follow-up through 3 years. Data were from the Abdominal Core Health Quality Collaborative (ACHQC), a prospective, multi-institutional clinical registry. Participants were adults undergoing primary or incisional VHR whose data were recorded in the ACHQC database. Data analysis was performed from May to September 2026.
EXPOSURES: Sex (female vs male).
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Primary outcomes included 30-day wound morbidity, comprising surgical site infection (SSI), surgical-site occurrence (SSO), and SSO requiring procedural intervention (SSO-PI), readmission, and length of stay. Secondary outcomes included pragmatic recurrence at 30 days, 1 year, 2 years, and 3 years and patient-reported quality of life and pain. Multivariable logistic regression assessed associations between sex and outcomes.
RESULTS: Among 31 358 patients, 14 303 (45.6%) were female and 17 055 (54.4%) were male. Women were younger than men (mean [SD] age, 55.0 [14.6] vs 56.5 [13.0] years, respectively) and had higher body mass index (mean [SD], 32.1 [7.6] vs 31.7 [5.9], respectively). Women presented with more complex hernia phenotypes, including higher rates of incisional, recurrent, and larger hernias. Compared with men, women experienced higher 30-day readmission (483 [3.4%] for women vs 428 [2.5%] for men), SSI (370 [2.6%] vs 284 [1.7%], respectively) SSO (1323 [9.2%] and 1286 [7.5%], respectively), and SSO-PI (517 [3.6%] vs 434 [2.5%], respectively; all P < .001), with no differences in reoperation or mortality. Female sex was independently associated with higher odds of SSI (odds ratio [OR], 1.40; 95% CI, 1.17-1.67) and SSO-PI (OR, 1.21; 95% CI, 1.04-1.40) after incisional hernia repair. Clinical outcomes and recurrence were similar at 1 year; however, women had higher recurrence at 2 years (444 [19.3%] vs 406 [15.7%] men) and 3 years (351 [20.9%] vs 320 [17.6%] men). Women reported worse baseline quality of life and pain but greater improvement after 1 year.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: This study found that women undergoing VHR presented with greater hernia complexity and experienced higher early wound morbidity and increased late recurrence, while achieving substantial patient-reported benefit. These findings may inform sex-specific risk stratification and counseling, although further studies with more longitudinal follow-up are needed.

makaleler.baslik: Prophylactic closed-incision negative pressure wound therapy for open ventral incisional hernia repair with mesh: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Herni Onarımında Kapalı İnsizyon Negatif Basınçlı Yara Tedavisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 420 hastayı içeren 4 RCT'lik meta-analizde ciNPWT, cerrahi alan enfeksiyonu riskini anlamlı düzeyde azaltmazken (RR 0,52; p=0,06) postoperatif hastanede kalış süresini kısaltmıştır (MD -1,02 gün; p=0,0007). Ancak kanıt kalitesi düşük veya çok düşüktür.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To systematically evaluate the effects of prophylactic closed-incision negative pressure wound therapy (ciNPWT) on surgical site infection (SSI), seroma incidence and length of hospital stay after open ventral incisional hernia repair with mesh.
METHODS: Four databases (Cochrane Library, Embase, PubMed, Web of Science) were searched from inception to June 2026 for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing prophylactic ciNPWT versus conventional sterile dressings in open ventral incisional hernia repair with mesh. The primary outcome was postoperative SSI incidence; secondary outcomes included seroma incidence and hospital stay. Study quality was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias tool (RoB 1.0), and meta-analysis was performed with both fixed-effect and random-effects models using RevMan software. The certainty of evidence was assessed using the GRADE approach.
RESULTS: Four RCTs involving 420 patients (208 in ciNPWT group, 212 in control group) were included. Under the fixed-effect model, ciNPWT tended to reduce SSI risk without statistical significance (RR = 0.52, 95% CI 0.26-1.04, P = 0.06, I2  = 50%). The random-effects model yielded a consistent but more conservative estimate (RR = 0.55, 95% CI 0.20-1.53, P = 0.25). No significant difference was found in seroma incidence (RR = 0.83, 95% CI 0.39-1.74, P = 0.61). ciNPWT was associated with shortened postoperative hospital stay (MD = -1.02 days, 95% CI -1.61 to -0.43, P = 0.0007), though this finding was based on only two studies and driven primarily by a single trial. Sensitivity analysis indicated that the SSI result was materially influenced by a single trial. Given the small number of included studies (k = 4), funnel plot asymmetry could not be reliably interpreted as evidence of publication bias. The GRADE certainty of evidence was rated as low for SSI and very low for seroma and hospital stay.
CONCLUSION: Current evidence from randomized controlled trials suggests that prophylactic ciNPWT may be associated with shortened hospital stay after mesh-based ventral incisional hernia repair and shows a non-significant trend toward reducing SSI and seroma. However, the certainty of evidence is low to very low, the SSI result is materially dependent on a single trial, and the hospital stay finding is inconsistent across studies. Therefore, no definitive conclusion can be drawn regarding infection reduction, and the hospital stay benefit requires confirmation. More large-sample, multicenter, high-quality RCTs are needed for further validation.

makaleler.baslik: The effect of goal-directed fluid therapy on endothelial glycocalyx and short-term postoperative recovery quality in older patients undergoing laparoscopic hernia or gallbladder surgery: a randomized controlled double-blind clinical study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Laparoskopik Cerrahi ve Hedefe Yönelik Sıvı Tedavisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Yaşlı hastalarda laparoskopik herni veya safra kesesi cerrahisinde uygulanan hedefe yönelik sıvı tedavisinin endotel glikokaliks degradasyonunu azalttığı ve QoR-15 skorlarını yükselttiği 60 hastalıklı bir RCT'de gösterildi.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: This study aimed to observe the effects of intraoperative goal-directed fluid therapy on postoperative recovery in older patients undergoing laparoscopic hernia or gallbladder surgery.
METHODS: A total of 60 older patients were randomly assigned to the control group (C group) and the goal- directed fluid therapy group (G group). The primary outcome was the plasma concentration of syndecan-1. The secondary outcomes were the plasma concentrations of tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-α), interleukin-1 (IL-1), intercellular adhesion molecule-1 (ICAM-1), and vascular cell adhesion molecule-1 (VCAM-1); mean arterial pressure; heart rate; regional cerebral oxygen saturation; intraoperative dopamine dosage; QoR-15 scale score; hematocrit; and postoperative adverse events.
RESULTS: Compared with the C group, the G group showed decreased plasma concentrations of ICAM-1 at the end of surgery and 24 h after surgery (P = 0.010 and 0.005, respectively), decreased plasma concentrations of syndecan-1 at the end of surgery (P = 0.049), more significantly decreased plasma concentrations of VCAM-1 at the end of surgery and 24 h after surgery (P < 0.001 and P = 0.017, respectively), and decreased plasma concentrations of IL-1β at the end of surgery and 24 h after surgery (P = 0.009 and 0.008, respectively). The C group showed increased plasma concentration of TNF-α at the end of surgery and 24 h after surgery compared with those before surgery (P = 0.003 and 0.023, respectively). Compared with the C group, the QoR-15 scores were higher at 24, 48, and 72 h after surgery (P = 0.001, 0.001, and 0.005, respectively) in the treatment group.
CONCLUSION: Intraoperative goal-directed fluid therapy in non-critically ill older patients may alleviate endothelial glycocalyx degradation with a lower incidence of adverse events.

tez.baslik: Laparoskopik tek taraflı TEP (total ekstraperitoneal) herniorafilerde preperitoneal ve trokar giriş yeri lokal anestezik infiltrasyonu ile ultrasonografi eşliğinde bilateral TAP (Transversus Abdominis Plane) bloğunun postoperatif analjezik etkinliklerinin karşılaştırılması
tez.baslik_tr: TEP Herniorafide TAP Blok ile Lokal Anestezik İnfiltrasyonu
tez.kisa_ozet: 60 hastanın alındığı prospektif randomize çalışmada, tek taraflı TEP herni onarımı sonrası USG eşliğinde bilateral TAP blok ve lokal anestezik infiltrasyonu benzer VAS skorları göstermiştir. TAP blok ilk 24 saatte ek parasetamol ihtiyacını azaltmıştır.
tez.ozet: ÖZET Amaç: Bu çalışmada, laparoskopik tek taraflı total ekstraperitoneal (TEP) inguinal herni onarımı yapılan hastalarda preperitoneal ve trokar giriş yeri lokal anestezik infiltrasyonu ile ultrasonografi (USG) eşliğinde uygulanan bilateral Transversus Abdominis Plane (TAP) bloğun postoperatif analjezik etkinliklerinin karşılaştırılması amaçlandı. Gereç ve Yöntem: Prospektif ve randomize olarak planlanan çalışmaya laparoskopik tek taraflı TEP inguinal herni onarımı yapılan toplam 60 hasta dahil edildi. Hastalar iki gruba ayrıldı. Grup I'de preperitoneal alana ve trokar giriş yerlerine lokal anestezik infiltrasyonu uygulandı. Grup II'de ise cerrahi işlem tamamlandıktan sonra ultrasonografi eşliğinde bilateral TAP blok yapıldı. Tüm hastalara multimodal analjezi protokolü kapsamında postoperatif analjezi uygulandı. Postoperatif ağrı düzeyi 1., 6., 12. ve 24. saatlerde Visual Analog Scale (VAS) ile değerlendirildi. Ek analjezik ihtiyacı, zaman aralıklarına göre parasetamol kullanımı ve ilk 24 saatteki toplam parasetamol ihtiyacı üzerinden kaydedildi. Ayrıca kompozit ağrı skoru ve net klinik fayda skoru hesaplandı. Bulgular: Gruplar arasında yaş, kilo, boy, ASA skoru, operasyon süresi, komorbidite varlığı ve sigara kullanımı açısından istatistiksel olarak anlamlı fark saptanmadı. Pain Responder Analizi sonucu her iki yaklaşım da benzer düzeyde kabul edilebilir ağrı kontrolü sağlamıştır. Postoperatif 1., 6., 12. ve 24. saat VAS skorları açısından iki grup arasında anlamlı fark bulunmadı. Ancak 6–12 saatlik dönemde parasetamol ihtiyacı TAP blok grubunda anlamlı olarak daha düşüktü. İlk 24 saatte toplam parasetamol ihtiyacı da TAP blok grubunda preperitoneal ve trokar giriş yeri lokal anestezik infiltrasyonu grubuna göre anlamlı düzeyde daha az saptandı. Kompozit değerlendirmelerde TAP blok grubunda daha düşük ağrı yükü ve daha iyi net klinik fayda profili izlendi. Sonuç: Laparoskopik tek taraflı TEP inguinal herni onarımı sonrası preperitoneal ve trokar giriş yeri lokal anestezik infiltrasyonu ile ultrasonografi eşliğinde bilateral TAP blok, postoperatif VAS skorları açısından benzer analjezik etkinlik göstermiştir. TAP blok, ek parasetamol ihtiyacını azaltma ve toplam klinik tedavi yükünü düşürme açısından avantaj sağlayabilir. Bununla birlikte preperitoneal ve trokar giriş yeri lokal anestezik infiltrasyonu; benzer ağrı kontrolü sağlaması, daha az lokal anestezik gerektirmesi, ek ultrasonografi cihazı ve rejyonal blok ekipmanı gerektirmemesi, zaman tasarrufu, teknik tecrübe gerektirmemesi, lokal anestezik sistemik toksisite riskinin (LAST) daha az olması nedeniyle klinik uygulanabilirlik ve kaynak kullanımı açısından pratik bir seçenek olarak değerlendirilebilir. Anahtar Kelimeler: İnguinal herni; Laparoskopi, Transversus abdominis plan bloğu; Lokal anestezikler, Postoperatif ağrı; Multimodal analjezi.

makaleler.baslik: Application of a nursing care bundle combined with a clinical nursing pathway in liver transplantation and its impact on patient self-management: a randomized controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Karaciğer Transplantasyonunda Bakım Paketi ve Klinik Yol
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 100 hastalık tek merkezli RCT'de karaciğer transplantasyonu sonrası bakım paketi ve klinik hemşirelik yolu uygulaması, kontrol grubuna kıyasla öz-yönetim ve ilaç uyumunu artırmış, biokimyasal göstergeleri iyileştirmiştir (p<0,05).
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to explore the effects of a nursing care bundle combined with a clinical nursing pathway on self-management ability, postoperative biochemical markers, medication adherence, psychological status, and quality of life among liver transplant recipients.
METHODS: This study was a single-center, prospective, randomized controlled trial. A total of 103 patients who underwent liver transplantation were initially screened. Three individuals were excluded due to severe postoperative complications (n = 1), incomplete medical records (n = 1), or inability to adhere to follow-up procedures (n = 1). The remaining 100 patients completed follow-up and were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to either the control group (n = 50) or the intervention group (n = 50) using a random number table. The control group received routine perioperative nursing care and standard follow-up after discharge. The intervention group received a structured nursing care bundle integrated with a clinical nursing pathway under the enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) framework. Primary outcome included self-management ability [assessed using the Chinese version of the Exercise of Self-Care Agency Scale (ESCA)]. Secondary outcomes included postoperative biochemical indicators at 1 and 6 months after discharge [including fasting blood glucose (FBG), 2-hour postprandial blood glucose (2 h-PBG), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), serum creatinine (SCr), total bilirubin (TBil), blood urea nitrogen (BUN), and therapeutic drug concentrations], medication adherence [assessed by the Basel Assessment of Adherence to Immunosuppressive Medications Scale (BAASIS)], psychological status [measured by the Self-Rating Depression Scale (SDS) and Self-Rating Anxiety Scale (SAS)], and quality of life (evaluated using the GQOLI-74 questionnaire).
RESULTS: At both 1 and 6 months following discharge, patients in the intervention group demonstrated better biochemical outcomes, including lower FBG, 2 h-PBG, ALT, SCr, TBil, and BUN levels, as well as more stable drug concentrations compared with the control group (P < 0.05). Furthermore, ESCA scores, BAASIS scores, and GQOLI-74 scores were all higher in the intervention group than in the control group (P < 0.05). SDS and SAS scores were reduced in the intervention group relative to the control group (P < 0.05).
CONCLUSION: The integration of a nursing care bundle with a clinical nursing pathway has a positive effect on improving self-management ability and medication adherence, optimizing postoperative biochemical indicators, alleviating negative emotions, and enhancing quality of life in liver transplant patients.

makaleler.baslik: A randomized controlled trial of normothermic versus dual-hypothermic oxygenated ex-situ perfusion in DCD liver transplantation.
makaleler.baslik_tr: DCD Karaciğer Transplantasyonunda D-HOPE ve NMP Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: NRP sonrası 50 greftin randomize edildiği bir çalışmada, D-HOPE ve NMP yöntemlerinin DCD karaciğer transplantasyonunda benzer orta dönem klinik sonuçlar sağladığı gösterilmiştir; 1 yıllık SAE oranı %16 ile %20 bulunmuştur (p=0,31).
makaleler.ozet: DCD liver transplantation has expanded worldwide but remains associated with an increased risk of complications. Sequential use of normothermic regional perfusion (NRP) followed by ex-situ machine perfusion (MP) is increasingly adopted but the choice of MP technique remains controversial. This randomized controlled trial compares outcomes of dual-hypothermic oxygenated perfusion (D-HOPE) versus normothermic machine perfusion (NMP) following NRP in DCD liver transplantation. After NRP, 50 grafts (44 controlled and 6 uncontrolled DCD) were randomized 1:1 to D-HOPE or NMP using concealed allocation with sequentially numbered sealed envelopes. Ex-situ perfusion was not performed for additional assessment. The primary endpoint was 1-year incidence of serious adverse events (SAE), including graft or patient loss and biliary or vascular complications. Secondary endpoint included other perioperative outcomes. We have also performed an exploratory analysis to identify predictive factors of graft loss and SAE. No case of primary non-function or vascular complication occurred. One-year graft and patient survival were both 88% in the D-HOPE group and 100% in the NMP group (p=0.07). One-year SAE rate was similar (16%vs.20%, p=0.31). Biliary leakage and postoperative dialysis rate were comparable between the two groups (16%vs.0%, p=0.12). Blood pH variation, lactate and IL-6 levels during NRP, perfusate lactate trend, portal flow, IL-6, IL-10 and TNF levels during D-HOPE and perfusate pH variations and IL-10 levels during NMP were related to graft loss. Conclusions: When applied after NRP, D-HOPE and NMP provide comparable mid-term clinical outcomes in DCD liver transplantation. Differences in specific complications may require individualized selection of ex-situ MP. The limited sample size and number of events preclude definitive conclusions regarding differences in individual complications or the relative efficacy of either ex-situ perfusion strategy. The observed differences in specific complications and exploratory associations with perfusion parameters warrant evaluation in larger prospective studies.

makaleler.baslik: Regional analgesic techniques for postoperative pain after kidney transplantation: a systematic review and Bayesian meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Böbrek Nakli Sonrası Ağrı için Rejyonel Analjezi Teknikleri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 14 çalışmayı kapsayan meta-analizde (903 katılımcı), QL ve TAP bloklarının 24. saatte opioid tüketimini anlamlı düzeyde azalttığı gösterilmiştir (QL için -15,5 mg; TAP için -10,5 mg).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Pain after kidney transplantation is often severe, and graft function constrains the use of systemic analgesia. Previous syntheses of regional techniques pooled them as a class, combined donors with recipients, and did not use a minimal clinically important difference (MCID).
METHODS: We searched PubMed, Embase, and CENTRAL through 5 September 2026 for randomised trials of regional analgesia in adult kidney transplant recipients (PROSPERO CRD420261478933); a trial-registry search and network meta-analysis were added post hoc. Bayesian random-effects models with MCID-scaled priors yielded posterior probabilities of benefit and of exceeding the MCID, and certainty of evidence was assessed using the GRADE framework.
RESULTS: Fourteen trials (903 participants) were included. Only quadratus lumborum (QL) and transversus abdominis plane (TAP) blocks could be pooled against control. Both yielded lower pain at every pooled time point, but no pairwise pain comparison reached 80% probability of exceeding the 1.0 point MCID. Opioid consumption at 24 h was lower with the QL block (-15.5 morphine milligram equivalents; 95% credible interval -23.6 to -6.7) and the TAP block (-10.5; -14.4 to -5.5), with each reduction exceeding the 5 mg MCID with a probability >97%. In the network meta-analysis, no difference between QL and TAP blocks in pain or opioid consumption reached 80% probability of exceeding the MCID. Graft function and safety data were too sparse to pool. Twelve eligible registered trials were unpublished; certainty of evidence was very low.
CONCLUSIONS: Quadrtus lumborum and transversus abdominus plane blocks reduce pain and opioid consumption at 24 h, but only the reduction in opioid consumption has a high probability of being clinically important. Certainty of evidence is very low; no technique is preferred, and effects on graft function are unknown.

makaleler.baslik: Graft-to-recipient weight ratio, graft inflow modulation, and small-for-size syndrome: A multicenter prospective study from the International LDLT registry (LDLTregistry.org).
makaleler.baslik_tr: Canlı Vericili Karaciğer Naklinde Greft Ağırlığı ve SFSS İlişkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Uluslararası bir kayıttan 55 merkezde yapılan 1944 canlı vericili karaciğer naklinde, greft-alıcı ağırlık oranının (GRWR) küçük greft sendromu (SFSS) riskini tek başına tam olarak açıklamadığı gösterildi. Genel SFSS insidansı %36,9 olup, GRWR <%0,60 grubunda anlamlı düzeyde daha yüksek (%47,6) saptandı (p<0,001). 90 günlük mortalite tüm gruplarda <%5 kaldı.
makaleler.ozet: Graft-to-recipient weight ratio (GRWR) is widely used to guide graft selection in living donor liver transplantation (LDLT); however, its role as an independent predictor of postoperative outcomes and small-for-size syndrome (SFSS) remains debated. Graft inflow modulation (GIM) has been increasingly adopted to allow the safe use of smaller grafts. This study evaluated the impact of GRWR and GIM on short-term outcomes using data from a prospective international registry. An analysis of prospectively collected data from the International Living Donor Liver Transplant Registry (LDLTregistry.org) was conducted, including 1944 consecutive LDLT procedures performed at 55 centers (September 2023 to February 2025). Recipients were stratified by GRWR (<0.60%, 0.60%-0.80%, >0.80%). Primary outcomes included major postoperative complications (Clavien-Dindo ≥3a), SFSS, and 90-day mortality. Lower GRWR was associated with higher rates of major complications, SFSS, and GIM use. Overall SFSS incidence, classified according to the ILTS-iLDLT-LTSI Consensus Conference Guidelines, was 36.9%, grade B in 17.0%, and grade C in 4.0%. SFSS of any grade increased progressively with lower GRWR: 33.4% in GRWR >0.80%, 43.7% in GRWR 0.60%-0.80%, and 63.1% in GRWR <0.60% (p<0.001). Grade A SFSS was similar across groups (p=0.12), whereas clinically significant SFSS (grades B and C) was highest in the GRWR < 0.6% group (47.6%, p<0.001). In all, 90-day mortality remained low (<5%) across all groups. Nearly half of small grafts were unexpectedly small, without worse short-term outcomes. On multivariable analysis, GRWR was not associated with major complications. GRWR influences short-term outcomes after LDLT but does not fully explain SFSS risk, which appears multifactorial. These findings support a shift away from graft size as the sole determinant of risk, toward a physiology-based, lobe-specific, and standardized intraoperative approach in LDLT.

makaleler.baslik: Differences in excess mortality by recipient sex after liver transplant.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Karaciğer Nakli Sonrası Alıcı Cinsiyetine Göre Ekstra Mortalite
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 218.429 hastanın dahil olduğu iki aşamalı bireysel hasta verisi meta-analizinde, ilk 3 ay içinde 25 yaş ve üzeri kadın alıcıların, donör cinsiyetinden bağımsız olarak anlamlı derecede yüksek ekstra mortalite gösterdiği saptandı. İlk 3 ayı atlatan 25 yaş üstü kadınlarda ise bu risk benzer veya erkeklere göre daha düşük bulundu.
makaleler.ozet: Identification of sex differences in mortality may prompt sex-specific management strategies. Males worldwide have higher mortality than females; therefore, we compared sex differences in excess mortality. We compared excess mortality in female versus male first liver transplant recipients, accounting for modifying effects of donor sex and recipient current age using relative survival models. Models were fitted separately in Scientific Registry of Transplant Recipients and CTS cohorts (1988-2019) and subsequently combined using two-stage individual patient data meta-analysis. We analyzed 218,429 patients. Within the first 3 months post-transplant, female recipients ≥25 years showed significantly higher excess mortality regardless of donor sex and female recipients 13-24 years had significantly higher excess mortality when the donor was male. Subsequent to the first 3 months, female recipients 0-12 years had significantly lower excess mortality regardless of donor sex; female recipients ≥25 years had lower excess mortality, though only significantly among those 25-44 years with a female donor. Females ≥25 years showed higher excess mortality than males in the immediate post-transplant period but, among those who survived, the first 3 months, excess mortality was similar by sex or lower in females than males. After the first 3 months post-transplant, female recipients 0-12 years showed lower excess mortality.

tez.baslik: Karaciğer nakli alıcılarında perioperatif risk faktörleri, erken dönem mortalite ve komplikasyonların analizi: Tek merkez deneyimi
tez.baslik_tr: Canlı Vericili Karaciğer Nakli Alıcılarında Perioperatif Risk Faktörleri
tez.kisa_ozet: Tek merkezde canlı vericili karaciğer nakli yapılan 60 hastanın incelendiği retrospektif çalışmada, ilk 30 gün içinde komplikasyon oranı %31,7 (19 hasta) ve otuz günlük mortalite oranı %10 (6 hasta) olarak saptandı. HCC tanısı olanlarda erken dönem komplikasyon oranı anlamlı yüksek bulunurken (p=0,028), MELD skoru 20 ve üzeri olanlarda komplikasyon riski artış eğilimi gösterdi.
tez.ozet: Bu çalışmanın amacı, karaciğer nakli yapılan hastalarda erken dönemde gelişen komplikasyon ve mortalite oranlarını belirlemek ve bu sonuçlara etki eden perioperatif risk faktörlerini analiz etmektir. Mayıs 2023 ile Eylül 2025 tarihleri arasında merkezimizde gerçekleştirilen karaciğer nakli alıcılarında retrospektif bir çalışma gerçekleştirildi. Donörlerin tamamı canlı verici idi. Hastaların demografik özellikleri ve ameliyat verileri ile perioperatif risk faktörleri kaydedildi. Postoperatif erken dönemde (30 gün içinde) ortaya çıkan komplikasyonlar ve mortalite oranları değerlendirildi. İstatistiksel analizlerde erken dönem komplikasyon ve mortalite riskine etki eden faktörleri belirlemek için başlangıçta tek değişkenli lojistik regresyon, ardından anlamlı bulunan değişkenlerle çok değişkenli lojistik regresyon analizleri uygulandı. Toplam 60 hastanın 19'unda (%31,7) ilk 30 gün içinde en az bir komplikasyon gelişti. Otuz günlük mortalite oranı %10 (6 hasta) olarak saptandı. Hepatoselüler karsinom (HCC) tanılı alıcılarda erken dönem komplikasyon oranı, diğer endikasyonlara sahip hastalara kıyasla anlamlı derecede daha yüksekti (p=0,028). MELD skoru 20 ve üzeri olan hastalarda komplikasyon gelişme olasılığı, MELD 0,05). Sonuç olarak bu bulgular doğrultusunda, yüksek riskli hastaların perioperatif dönemde daha yakından izlenmesi ve olası komplikasyonların erken tanı ve tedavisiyle kısa dönem sonuçların iyileştirilebileceği düşünülmektedir. Anahtar Kelimeler: Karaciğer nakli, soğuk iskemi, perioperatif risk faktörleri, MELD skoru, HCC

makaleler.baslik: Surgical Margin and Risk of Local Recurrence in Children and Young Adults With Nonrhabdomyosarcoma Soft Tissue Sarcoma: A Nonrandomized Clinical Trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Nonrhabdomyosarcoma Yumuşak Doku Sarkomunda Cerrahi Sınır
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 266 hastada yapılan prospektif çalışmada, nonrhabdomyosarcoma yumuşak doku sarkomu için R0 rezeksiyon sonrası 5 yıllık lokal nüks insidansı %4,4 bulundu. 6 mm ve üzeri cerrahi sınırlarda nüks izlenmezken, 1 mm'de %4,9, 2-5 mm'de %2,0 olarak saptandı. Geniş cerrahi sınırlar lokal nüks riskini daha da azaltmaktadır.
makaleler.ozet:
IMPORTANCE: The extent of negative margin necessary to achieve a high rate of local tumor control in children and young adult patients with nonrhabdomyosarcoma soft tissue sarcomas (NRSTS) is unknown.
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the impact of negative margin extent on local tumor control in children and young adult patients with NRSTS undergoing R0 resection as part of risk-adapted multimodality treatment.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This multicenter prospective clinical trial was conducted at Children's Oncology Group (COG) member sites from February 2007 through February 2012. Analysis was performed on the final dataset June 30, 2018, with a median follow-up of 6.2 years. Reviewers of margin status/extent were blinded to local control outcomes. Patients included 266 eligible/evaluable individuals younger than 30 years with nonmetastatic NRSTS who were enrolled in the COG ARST0332 trial and underwent upfront or delayed R0 resection as part of treatment. Patients who underwent an amputation or did not receive protocol-specified radiotherapy were excluded. These data were analyzed from January 2023 through July 2026.
INTERVENTION: Risk-adapted treatment included 3 patient groups with upfront or delayed surgery with or without radiation therapy with or without ifosfamide/doxorubicin chemotherapy, based on the extent of initial resection, surgical margin status, tumor size, and histologic grade.
MAIN OUTCOMES: Cumulative incidence of local recurrence based on treatment approach and surgical margin extent and outcomes after local recurrence.
RESULTS: Of 266 patients (median age 13.7 [range, 2.1-27.6] years; 138 female [52%] and 128 male [48%]) who underwent upfront (n = 207) or delayed (n = 59) R0 resection, 132 had measured surgical margins: 1 mm (n = 56), 2 to 5 mm (n = 50), or 6-mm or larger (n = 26). The 5-year cumulative incidence of local recurrence overall was 4.4%. Local recurrence occurred in 10 of 178 patients treated with surgery alone (5.6%) and 2 of 88 patients treated with surgery and chemoradiotherapy (2.3%). Among the 132 patients with measured surgical margins, the 5-year cumulative incidence of local recurrence was 4.9% for 1-mm margins, 2.0% for 2- to 5-mm margins, and 0% for 6-mm or larger margins. Local recurrence occurred in 10 of 178 (5.6%) patients with tumors smaller than 5 cm treated with margin-negative surgery alone, 1 of 29 (3.4%) patients with tumors larger than 5 cm treated with margin-negative surgery followed by chemoradiotherapy, and 1 of 59 (1.7%) patients with initially unresectable disease treated with neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy. Five of 12 patients with local recurrence were alive without further disease progression.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this study, the local recurrence rate after R0 resection among children and young adult patients treated with risk-based therapy for nonmetastatic NRSTS was low, and some patients underwent successful salvage therapy with durable long-term disease control. Wider (>1 mm) negative margins further decrease local recurrence risk. Close surgical margins may be adequate in some clinical settings, particularly in the context of chemoradiotherapy, according to a risk-adapted approach.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT00346164.

makaleler.baslik: Survival Outcomes of Patients With Melanoma Treated With Mohs Micrographic Surgery: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Melanomda Mohs Mikrografik Cerrahi ve Sağkalım
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 500.000'den fazla hastayı içeren 13 çalışmanın meta-analizinde, kutanöz melanom için Mohs mikrografik cerrahi ile wide local excision kıyaslandı. Mohs cerrahisi ile uzun dönem overall survival (HR 0,93; %95 CI 0,87-0,99; p=0,03) ve disease-specific survival (HR 0,63; %95 CI 0,56-0,72; p<0,00001) anlamlı derecede yüksek bulundu.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Wide local excision (WLE) is the standard treatment for cutaneous melanoma. Mohs micrographic surgery (MMS), a tissue-sparing technique with comprehensive margin assessment, is an alternative in selected cases. With increased MMS use, its optimal scope for melanoma treatment remains under discussion due to the complexity of frozen-section interpretation and lack of randomized trials evaluating long-term outcomes.
OBJECTIVE: To compare survival between MMS and WLE for melanoma.
METHODS/MATERIALS: PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane databases were systematically searched for comparative studies reporting overall or disease-specific survival. Outcomes were compared using adjusted hazard ratios (95% confidence intervals). Heterogeneity was assessed with I2.
RESULTS: Thirteen studies with more than 500,000 individuals were included in the statistical analysis. Long-term overall (HR = 0.93; 95% CI = 0.87-0.99; p-value = .03) and disease-specific survival (HR = 0.63; 95% CI = 0.56-0.72; p-value<.00001) were significantly higher with MMS versus WLE. Overall survival benefit was mainly driven by head/neck melanoma (HR = 0.92; 95% CI = 0.86-0.99; p-value = .03), particularly invasive disease (HR = 0.91; 95% CI = 0.84-0.99; p-value = .03). Lentigo maligna subtype also showed higher overall survival with MMS (HR = 0.89; 95% CI = 0.82-0.97; p-value = .006). No difference was observed in 5-year overall or disease-specific survival (HR = 0.92; 95% CI = 0.80-1.05; p-value = .12 and HR = 0.87; 95% CI = 0.56-1.34; p-value = .52; respectively).
CONCLUSION: MMS was consistently associated with survival similar or superior to WLE, supporting its expanding role in melanoma management.

makaleler.baslik: Minimally Invasive Versus Open CRS/HIPEC for Peritoneal Surface Malignancies: Postoperative Recovery and Long-Term Outcomes-A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Peritoneal Malignitelerde Minimal İnvaziv ve Açık CRS/HIPEC
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 21 çalışmayı içeren 1184 hastalı meta-analizde, minimal invaziv CRS/HIPEC ile açık yaklaşım karşılaştırıldı. Minimal invaziv grupta daha az kan kaybı, daha az transfüzyon, daha yüksek CC0 oranı (RR 1,053; p=0,045) ve daha hızlı postoperatif iyileşme saptanırken, uzun dönem sağkalımda fark görülmedi.
makaleler.ozet: Background: Minimally invasive surgery (MIS) is increasingly implemented for cytoreductive surgery (CRS) combined with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) for peritoneal surface malignancies (PSM). This systematic review and meta-analysis compared minimally invasive CRS/HIPEC (M-CRS/HIPEC) and open CRS/HIPEC (O-CRS/HIPEC) in terms of perioperative, postoperative, and long-term oncological outcomes. Methods: A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted according to PRISMA guidelines. PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched for comparative studies of M-CRS/HIPEC versus O-CRS/HIPEC in adult patients. Risk of bias was assessed using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale and RoB 2.0. Pooled relative risks (RR) for dichotomous outcomes and standardized mean differences (SMD) for continuous outcomes were calculated with 95% confidence intervals (CI). Sensitivity analyses were performed to assess the potential influence of disease burden and primary tumor heterogeneity. Results: Twenty-one studies (1 randomized controlled trial and 20 retrospective cohorts) including 1184 patients (452 M-CRS/HIPEC and 732 O-CRS/HIPEC) were analyzed. Operative time did not differ between groups (SMD = 0.195; p = 0.667). Most cytoreductive procedures were comparable, although small bowel resections were less frequent with M-CRS/HIPEC (RR = 0.537; p = 0.018). The minimally invasive approach achieved higher CC0 rates (RR = 1.053; p = 0.045), with lower blood loss (SMD = -1.838; p < 0.001) and fewer transfusions (RR = 0.588; p = 0.002). Postoperative recovery favored M-CRS/HIPEC, with earlier return of bowel function and resumption of oral intake, shorter hospital stay, fewer readmissions, and earlier chemotherapy resumption (all p < 0.05). Overall and major morbidity were reduced, while postoperative mortality and 1-, 3-, and 5-year disease-free and overall survival did not differ significantly between groups. In the disease burden-restricted sensitivity analysis, differences in small bowel resection, CC0 rate, and 90-day readmission were no longer statistically significant, whereas the main perioperative and recovery benefits persisted. No significant differences in DFS or OS were identified in the additional sensitivity analyses at the evaluable time points. Conclusions: This meta-analysis supports a selective, expertise-driven use of M-CRS/HIPEC, offering perioperative and recovery advantages without significant differences in cytoreductive adequacy or long-term outcomes in appropriately selected patients.

makaleler.baslik: Patterns and Predictors of Relapse Following Cytoreductive Surgery for Pseudomyxoma Peritonei.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pseudomyxoma Peritonei CRS Sonrası Nüks Prediktörleri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Apendikeal pseudomyxoma peritonei nedeniyle CRS yapılan 204 hastanın retrospektif kohort çalışmasında, hastaların %44'ünde nüks geliştiği saptandı. 3 yıllık progression-free survival %50,2 ve overall survival %75,6 idi; yüksek derece histoloji ve komplet rezeksiyonun tam olmaması nüks için bağımsız öngörücülerdi.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the incidence, timing and anatomical pattern of relapse after cytoreductive surgery (CRS) for pseudomyxoma peritonei (PMP), and identify predictors of overall and early (within 12 months) relapse.
METHODS: Retrospective cohort study of consecutive patients undergoing curative-intent CRS for appendiceal PMP at a single institution (2016-2025), recording the site of first relapse. Predictors of progression-free survival (PFS) and early relapse were evaluated using Cox and logistic regression.
RESULTS: Among 204 patients, CC-0/1 cytoreduction was achieved in 89% and HIPEC in 92%. At 37.1-month median follow-up, 89 patients (44%) relapsed; 3-year PFS and overall survival were 50.2% and 75.6%. Relapse was predominantly intraperitoneal, most often the pelvis and small bowel/mesentery (25% each). Histology and completeness of cytoreduction independently predicted PFS: low-grade (HR 2.18), high-grade (HR 2.79) and signet-ring PMP (HR 4.35) vs acellular mucin, CC-2/3 (HR 2.18), and male sex (HR 1.74). Early relapse occurred in 34 patients (17%), independently predicted by high-grade histology (OR 5.06) and CC-2/3 (OR 3.55).
CONCLUSION: Relapse after CRS for PMP is predominantly intraperitoneal, most often the small bowel/mesentery and pelvis. Histology and completeness of cytoreduction are the principal determinants of overall and early relapse, supporting risk-stratified surveillance and selective repeat cytoreduction.

makaleler.baslik: Preoperative Frailty as a Predictor of Quality of Life Outcomes Following Cytoreductive Surgery.
makaleler.baslik_tr: CRS + HIPEC Sonrası Yaşam Kalitesinde Preoperatif Frailty'nin Rolü
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 364 hastayla yapılan retrospektif kohort çalışmasında, preoperatif frailty CRS + HIPEC sonrası daha zayıf QoL sonuçlarıyla anlamlı düzeyde ilişkili bulundu. Frail hastalarda mobilite ve fiziksel skorlar 3 ve 6 ay boyunca düşük kalmaya devam etti. Rutin frailty taraması ve prehabilitasyon stratejilerinin önemi vurgulandı.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Frailty has emerged as a critical determinant of postoperative risk in patients undergoing cytoreductive surgery with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (CRS + HIPEC). However, its impact on postoperative quality of life (QoL) remains underexplored. Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate the association between preoperative frailty and postoperative QoL in patients undergoing CRS + HIPEC.
METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included patients who underwent CRS + HIPEC at the Royal Prince Alfred Hospital between May 2017 and June 2024. Frailty was assessed using the Clinical Frailty Scale (CFS), with patients classified as frail (CFS ≥ 4) or non-frail (CFS < 4). QoL outcomes were evaluated using the EuroQol 5-Dimension 5-Level (EQ-5D-5 L) and Short Form-36 (SF-36) Health Survey at five time points. Subgroup analyses were conducted based on age (< 65 vs. ≥ 65 years).
RESULTS: Of the 364 included patients, 49 (13.5%) were classified as frail. Frailty was significantly associated with poorer QoL outcomes, particularly in mobility, self-care, usual activities, and physical component summary (PCS) scores (all p ≤ 0.003) at baseline. These impairments persisted at three and 6 months postoperatively. Pain and discomfort also emerged as significant issues for frail patients at both three- and 6-months following surgery (p = 0.018 and p = 0.005, respectively). Older frail patients (≥ 65 years) experienced significantly greater impairments in self-care and usual activities at 6 months postoperatively, along with lower mental health summary (MCS) scores at 12 months compared to the non-frail group.
CONCLUSIONS: Preoperative frailty was significantly associated with poorer QoL outcomes following CRS + HIPEC, highlighting the importance of routine frailty screening and prehabilitation strategies to optimize outcomes in vulnerable patients.

tez.baslik: Lokal ileri mide kanserli hastalarda yapılan evreleme FDG-PET/CT ve evreleme laparoskopisi bulgularının peritoneal implant açısından kıyaslanması
tez.baslik_tr: Mide Kanserinde Evreleme FDG-PET/CT ve Evreleme Laparoskopisi Karşılaştırması
tez.kisa_ozet: 43 mide kanserli hastada yapılan retrospektif tez çalışmasında peritoneal implant açısından FDG-PET/CT ve laparoskopi kıyaslandı. Her iki yöntemin özgüllüğü %100 bulunurken, duyarlılıkları sırasıyla %43 ve %100 olarak tespit edildi. Evreleme laparoskopisinin genel durumu cerrahiye uygun mide kanserli hastalarda yapılması gerektiği vurgulandı.
tez.ozet: Bu çalışmada 43 mide kanserli hastada endikasyon dahilinde klinik evrele-me için yapılmış olan FDG-PET/CT ve laparoskopinin peritoneal implant açısından bulgularının kıyaslanması hedeflendi. Gereç ve Yöntem Retrospektif olarak yapılan çalışmamızda hastalar peritoneal karsinomatoza durumuna göre iki gruba ayrıldı. Grup 1 peritoneal karsinomatoza tespit edilmeyen, grup 2 peritoneal karsinomatoza tespit edilen hastalardan oluşmaktadır. Analizler SPSS (Statistical Package for Social Sciences; SPSS Inc. Chicago, IL) 24 paket prog-ramında değerlendirildi. Analizlerde istatistiksel anlamlılık düzeyi p<0,05 olarak ka-bul edildi. Bulgular FDG-PET/CT ve evreleme laparoskopisinin peritoneal implant tespit açısından özgüllüğü her ikisi için %100 olarak bulundu. Duyarlılık ise sırasıyla %43 ve %100 olarak tespit edildi. Sonuç Evreleme için yüksek duyarlılık ve özgüllüğü nedeniyle klinik olarak uygun hastalar için yapılacak olan evreleme laparoskopisinin belirgin üstünlüğü göz önünde bulundurulduğunda evreleme FDG-PET/CT'nin nispeten düşük duyarlılığı nedeniyle evreleme laparoskopisinin yerini alamayacağını ve evreleme laparoskopisinin genel durumu cerrahiye uygun mide kanserli hastalarda evreleme amacıyla yapılması gerek-tiğini düşünmekteyiz. Anahtar sözcükler: Mide kanseri, Evreleme laparoskopisi, Evreleme FDG-PET/CT

makaleler.baslik: WSES-PSOGI-SICO evidence-infomed guidelines on surgical emergencies in patients with peritoneal surface malignancies: a systematic review, meta-analysis, and structured expert consensus.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Peritoneal Malignitelerde Acil Cerrahi Yönetimi İçin WSES-PSOGI-SICO Kılavuzu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Sistemik derleme, meta-analiz ve uzman konsensüsü ile peritoneal malignitelerle ilişkili malign barsak obstrüksiyonunun acil yönetimi incelenmiştir. Tıbbi tedavi daha düşük morbidite sağlarken, cerrahi daha yüksek klinik başarı (OR 2,57; %95 CI 1,47-4,50) göstermiştir. Tüm kılavuz önermeleri %100 uzlaşıya ulaşmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Peritoneal surface malignancies (PSM) are primary or secondary neoplastic deposits involving the peritoneum and are commonly associated with colorectal, gastric, appendiceal, gynecological, pancreaticobiliary, and other intra-abdominal or extra-abdominal cancers. Malignant bowel obstruction (MBO) is one of the most frequent and clinically consequential emergency presentations in this population, yet diagnostic and therapeutic pathways remain heterogeneous. We aimed to develop evidence-informed recommendations for emergency management of MBO in patients with PSM by integrating a systematic review, meta-analysis and a structured international expert consensus process.
METHODS: This systematic review, meta-analysis, and Delphi consensus followed PRISMA, Cochrane, and relevant MOOSE reporting principles. PubMed/MEDLINE and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception to June 2025 (English language). Five predefined PICO/PIRT questions addressed: (1) the diagnostic role of CT, plain abdominal X-ray, or Gastrografin-enhanced X-ray in PSM-related MBO; (2) nonoperative medical management versus surgical or endoscopic therapy; (3) surgical versus endoscopic treatment after failure of nonoperative management; (4) bowel resection versus stoma or bypass in surgical candidates; and (5) endoscopic stenting versus endoscopic ultrasound-guided bypass with lumen-apposing metal stents in endoscopic candidates. Study selection and data extraction were performed independently and in duplicate. Risk of bias was assessed with ROBINS-I for comparative non-randomized studies and MINORS for non-comparative studies; certainty of evidence was rated with GRADE. Random-effects meta-analyses (REML) produced odds ratios (OR), mean differences (MD), pooled means, or pooled proportions with 95% confidence intervals (CI); heterogeneity was summarized using I2, τ2, and 95% prediction intervals. Evidence profiles informed statements voted on by the WSES-PSOGI-SICO expert panel during the 2025 WSES Congress.
RESULTS: No comparative diagnostic study evaluated abdominal X-ray or Gastrografin-enhanced X-ray in PSM-related MBO; two small retrospective CT-based series supported contrast-enhanced CT for mapping obstruction and excluding urgent complications, but no diagnostic meta-analysis was possible. For medical versus procedural treatment, medical management was associated with lower morbidity (OR 0.16, 95% CI 0.07-0.39) and shorter length of stay (MD - 9.48 days, 95% CI - 12.65 to -6.32), while success, mortality, and overall survival remained inconclusive. For surgery versus endoscopy, surgery showed higher clinical success (OR 2.57, 95% CI 1.47-4.50), whereas endoscopy shortened hospital stay (MD 3.35 days, 95% CI 1.46-5.23); mortality did not differ (OR 1.02, 95% CI 0.70-1.49). Among surgical options, resection showed a signal toward higher perioperative mortality than bypass or ostomy (OR 3.55, 95% CI 1.45-8.68). Endoscopic stenting showed a pooled clinical success rate of 0.71 (95% CI 0.62-0.79), whereas evidence on LAMS was limited to one retrospective study. All guideline statements reached 100% agreement among voting participants.
CONCLUSIONS: Despite the low certainty of available evidence, integration of systematic review findings with expert consensus provides a structured international framework to support decision-making in emergency presentations of PSM-related MBO. These consensus-based recommendations are intended to assist clinicians in harmonizing care across peripheral and referral hospitals, while emphasizing individualized multidisciplinary judgement and the need for future higher-quality evidence.

makaleler.baslik: Endoscopic Ultrasound-Guided versus Endoscopic Transpapillary Gallbladder Drainage in High Surgical Risk Patients with Acute Cholecystitis: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Yüksek Cerrahi Riskli Akut Kolesistit Hastalarında Safra Kesesi Drenajı
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 1479 hastayı içeren 9 çalışmanın meta-analizinde, endoskopik ultrason kılavuzluğunda safra kesesi drenajı (EUS-GBD), transpapiller drenaja kıyasla daha yüksek teknik (OR 4,34; %95 CI 2,18-8,65) ve klinik başarı (OR 2,79; %95 CI 1,34-5,80) sağlamıştır. Ayrıca kolesistit nüksü daha düşük bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Endoscopic ultrasound-guided gallbladder drainage (EUS-GBD) and endoscopic transpapillary gallbladder drainage (ET-GBD) are alternatives for high surgical-risk patients with acute cholecystitis (AC). Their comparative efficacy and safety remain uncertain.
METHODS: Studies comparing EUS-GBD and ET-GBD in high surgical-risk AC patients were pooled using random-effects models, with subgroup analyses by stent type. Primary outcomes were technical and clinical success; secondary outcomes included recurrence of cholecystitis, post-procedure cholangitis, procedural time and adverse events (AEs). Trial sequential analysis (TSA) assessed conclusiveness.
RESULTS: Nine studies (1,479 patients) were included. EUS-GBD achieved higher technical success (odds ratio [OR], 4.34; 95% confidence interval [CI], 2.18-8.65) and clinical success (OR, 2.79; 95% CI, 1.34-5.80), with lower recurrence of cholecystitis (OR, 0.34; 95% CI, 0.18-0.66) and post-procedure cholangitis (OR, 0.22; 95% CI, 0.06-0.87). Overall AE rates were similar (OR, 1.16; 95% CI, 0.75-1.79), although bile leak was more frequent with EUS-GBD (OR, 5.90; 95% CI, 1.01-34.60). Procedural time was shorter with EUS-GBD (weighted mean difference, -13.17minutes; 95% CI, -23.64 to -2.70). Technical success favored EUS-GBD with all stent types, whereas clinical success and recurrence favored EUS-GBD with metal but not plastic stents, although subgroup differences were not significant. TSA supported the technical success and recurrence findings, but clinical success was less firmly established.
CONCLUSION: EUS-GBD offers superior technical and clinical success and reduces recurrence of cholecystitis and post-procedure cholangitis compared with ET-GBD in high surgical-risk AC patients. Bile leak may be more frequent. Stent-specific findings were exploratory. Prospective trials warranted to confirm these results and to evaluate cost-effectiveness.
makaleler.dergi_tam: Journal of gastrointestinal surgery : official journal of the Society for Surgery of the Alimentary Tract

makaleler.baslik: Diagnostic Accuracy of Computed Tomography Versus Diagnostic Laparoscopy for Detecting Diaphragmatic Injury in Left Thoracoabdominal Penetrating Trauma: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Sol Torakoabdominal Travmada Diyafram Yaralanması Tanısı
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 222 hastayı içeren meta-analizde, bilgisayarlı tomografinin (CT) diyafram yaralanmasındaki pooled duyarlılığı 0,70 (%95 CI 0,56-0,80) ve özgüllüğü 0,94 (%95 CI 0,89-0,97) bulunmuştur. Diagnostik laparoskopinin kesin dışlama için referans standart olduğu vurgulanmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Occult diaphragmatic injury occurs in 17%-54% of patients with left thoracoabdominal penetrating trauma and carries a substantial risk of delayed herniation, bowel strangulation, and mortality if missed. The comparative diagnostic performance of multidetector computed tomography (CT) and diagnostic laparoscopy (DL) in this specific population remains incompletely defined.
METHODS: A systematic review was conducted according to the PRISMA-DTA statement. PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar were searched from inception to August 2026. Diagnostic accuracy studies reporting CT findings against a surgical reference standard in adult patients with left thoracoabdominal penetrating trauma were included. The methodological quality was assessed with QUADAS-2. A bivariate random-effects model was used for pooled estimates.
RESULTS: Four primary diagnostic accuracy studies (222 patients with extractable 2 × 2 data) were included. Individual sensitivities of CT ranged from 50% to 82% and specificities from 88% to 100%. The pooled sensitivity of CT was 0.70 (95% CI 0.56-0.80; I2 = 36%) and the pooled specificity was 0.94 (95% CI 0.89-0.97; I2 = 0%). Qualitative evidence from seven additional studies demonstrated diaphragmatic injury rates of 23%-54% and high feasibility of therapeutic laparoscopy.
CONCLUSIONS: CT has high specificity but insufficient sensitivity to reliably exclude diaphragmatic injury after left thoracoabdominal penetrating trauma. Diagnostic laparoscopy remains the reference standard for definitive exclusion and permits immediate repair.
